articleTitle: Innovations in Image Forensics: Designing a Smart Learning Based Methodology for Forgery Detection over Digital Images
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Detecting forgery in digital images is crucial for several reasons. Firstly, with the widespread use and accessibility of image editing tools, individuals can easily manipulate digital images, raising concerns about the authenticity and integrity of visual information. This study introduces a novel approach, termed SFVGG, for detecting forgery in digital images by leveraging a smart learning methodology. The SFVGG method integrates the robust features of SIFT, the clustering capabilities of Fuzzy C-Mean clustering, and the deep learning process of VGG19. Through a synergistic combination of these techniques, the proposed forgery detection system achieves a comprehensive and effective solution. The methodology was implemented using Python, showcasing its practical applicability. Remarkably, the SFVGG framework demonstrates a high accuracy of 94.5%, underscoring its effectiveness in identifying forged content within digital images. This research represents a significant advancement in digital image forgery detection, offering both a sophisticated methodology and practical implementation.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Triple-Branch Diversity Receivers in Composite Gamma-Shadowed Rician Fading Channels with AMC and Asymmetric SNR Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This paper provides an in-depth analysis of the performance enhancement resulting from AMC in triple-branch diversity receivers under composite Gamma shadowed Rician fading channels with uneven SNR conditions. This paper was able to show the level of enhancement in average SNR resulting through simulations of AMC on signal quality in several receiver branches, which clearly shows AMC's ability in alleviating fading and shadowing based degradations. The analysis revealed that AMC adequately alleviates degradations by changing modulation schemes and coding rates based on the current quality of the channel. This reinforces AMC's ability to improve the link's reliability and likelihood to optimize the efficiency of the communication channel. This makes AMC a desirable design and optimization feature for wireless communication in highly fading and shadowed environments, which makes this innovation a potential fundamental technology in the realization of robust, resilient, and adaptive communication systems.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Smart Irrigation: Enhancing Agricultural Water Efficiency Through Intelligent Valve Regulation in Piped and Micro Irrigation Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This paper presents a revolutionary solution to optimize water use in agriculture, using an AI-based smart irrigation system. Our approach focuses on automatic adjustment of water release control valves, guided by artificial intelligence (AI) that takes into account the complex relationship between soil moisture and ambient temperature in the plant root zone. The decision-making process in our system is powered by a deep neural network meticulously trained on a comprehensive dataset, including the dynamic interaction of soil moisture, temperature changes of the crop. The reason for using an AI model that focuses specifically on the relationship between soil moisture and temperature lies in its ability to recognize small details, complex patterns and correlations that impact irrigation need. Traditional methods are often unable to adapt to the complex and dynamic nature of agricultural ecosystems. By harnessing the power of AI, our system not only captures, but also learns and predicts, optimal irrigation conditions, thereby promoting resource-efficient agricultural practices. The proposed system seamlessly integrates with micro-irrigation and pipeline networks, ensuring flexibility in different agricultural environments. Using MQTT communication powered by Node-RED, collected data is efficiently transmitted to the cloud, allowing real-time monitoring and analysis. This combination of AI, sensor technology and cloud connectivity aims to provide farmers with accurate information, promote water conservation, optimize crop yields and reduce environmental impact. Ultimately, our research contributes to advancing sustainable agriculture by addressing important challenges and paving the way for a new era of smart irrigation practices.

articleTitle: Enhancing Network Function Virtualization and Service Function Chaining: Innovative Optimization Strategies and Their Impact
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Throughout this paper, the reader was able to better understand how innovative optimization techniques through NFV and SFC frameworks could and should be applied to address the developing and shifting focus of contemporary network infrastructures. Focusing on performance metrics performance via latency, throughput, resource utilization, and operational cost, the presented algorithms and machine learning models developed and executed due to this research showed innovative and dynamic optimization of network functions. Through further extensive simulations equalling 125 seconds, our findings reported creative results of improving performance in several significant areas: latency was reduced, throughput was enhanced, resource utilization was more efficient, and operational cost was reduced. These results indicated that our optimization strategies can pay off and bring a number of benefits to NFV and SFC that address a clear need for change in the current type of network management models. Therefore, this paper is valuable and serves as a testament of our strategies' power along with opening various doors for following network optimization research. Therefore, one can see how important it is to implement innovation in the face of change.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Optimization for Sentiment Analysis in Movie Reviews Based on YouTube Comments
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This study offers an optimization for sentiment analysis in YouTube movie reviews that is driven by machine learning. The goal of the project is to create a solid model for sophisticated sentiment categorization by utilizing natural language processing and sentiment analysis methods. The technique includes extracting and preprocessing YouTube comments, applying cutting-edge machine learning algorithms, and feature engineering to obtain pertinent sentiment indicators. Improved precision and effectiveness in deciphering the range of emotions expressed in movie-related remarks are promised by the refined model. Results add to the body of knowledge on sentiment analysis research by providing insightful information about the potential and difficulties unique to YouTube movie reviews with accuracy 92%. For researchers, film studios, and content producers looking for a more nuanced understanding of audience attitudes within the vast expanse of YouTube comments, the suggested model is a potent tool.

articleTitle: Vision Transformer Implementation on Edge GPU (AGX Orin) for Image Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: With the use of vision transformers, the transformer architecture, which was first designed for natural language processing (NLP), has been adapted for computer vision applications. This paper introduces a robust approach for flower image classification leveraging a pre-trained Vision Transformer (ViT) model. The approach is optimized for flower classification tasks by using the Vision Transformer as the base model. Training images were enlarged and resized to improve the model's generalization skills. Furthermore, during the training phase, particular training parameters were set up to thoroughly assess the model's categorization accuracy. So, in this model we are basically classifying images into two classes of flowers that are daisy and dandelion. We have implemented this model on the NVIDIA AGX ORIN 64 GB developer kit. There are three power modes available in this kit i.e. 15W, 30W and 50 W. We have operated our GPU kit in all three modes and analyzed for all the parameters including power, memory utilization, CPU core utilization and accuracy etc. We have achieved 98.58 % training accuracy and 97.32 % testing accuracy while training our pre-trained model.

articleTitle: An Approach of Fog Computing and Edge Computing for Computing Resources Optimization Strategies
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This paper investigates optimization strategies for fog and edge computing systems, focusing on the key challenges of resource allocation, load balancing, latency minimization, and power efficiency. We analyze the results of the simulation study to determine the impact and potential of our strategies and find that the improvements achieved are small to moderate, varying between 1.75% and 2.95%. This knowledge demonstrates that system optimization requires small, gradual increments and that fog and edge computing are dynamic systems. Our results suggest that optimization based on integration and adaptability can produce a significant difference in the performance and reliability of distributed systems.

articleTitle: Advancing Water Quality Monitoring: A Comprehensive IoT-Based Approach for Safety Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In the context of Earth's evolution, effective water management has emerged as a critical factor for human survival. Recognizing the global risk posed by a drinking water crisis, the World Economic Forum highlights its severity, resulting in approximately 200 children succumbing daily. This paper aims to introduce an innovative solution: an automated concept basis of Internet of Things (IoT) Water Quality and Safety Measuring (WQSM) System. Utilizing ESP8266 (nodeMCU), The system employs various sensors for monitor diverse water parameters of real time across different water bodies. The system incorporates Turbidity, Temperature, and Ultrasonic sensors, all seamlessly connected to the ESP8266. This microcontroller processes and transmits the collected data to a webpage, offering real-time insights into water quality. The key innovation lies in the integration of a smart component, which assesses the data independently. Unlike conventional systems relying on predefined criteria, this approach allows the device to dynamically determine water purity and drinkability, reducing the margin of error. Ultimately, the presented cost-effective system represents a significant step towards real-time water monitoring and safety assurance for communities.

articleTitle: Reimagining Health Tracking: Raspberry Pi Innovations for Holistic Wellness
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This IoT-based health monitoring system, developed using Raspberry Pi, incorporates various devices and sensors to track individual health. By using light incidence, it measures oxygen and gas levels in the blood, representing a major technological advancement with a focus on adaptability in the modern world. It transmits data online, ensuring healthcare providers receive timely updates on patient metrics. Its compact design enhances user convenience while providing comprehensive insights into health conditions, aiding in disease detection and prevention. Based on IoT principles, it presents a cost-effective and intelligent alternative to similar hardware solutions, showcasing its effectiveness in health monitoring. The proposed system introduces an innovative IoT-driven wellness tracking solution centered on Raspberry Pi technology. It utilizes a range of sensors and devices to monitor health parameters, employing advanced techniques like light incidence to measure blood oxygen and gas levels. This method signifies a significant leap in health monitoring technology, emphasizing adaptability in today's context. By enabling real-time data transmission over the internet, the system ensures healthcare professionals can quickly access and evaluate patient metrics, improving the efficiency of medical interventions. Additionally, its small size and portability offer exceptional user convenience, allowing easy integration into daily routines. Beyond just collecting data, the system provides detailed insights into users' health conditions, facilitating early disease detection and prevention. Built on IoT principles, it offers a cost-effective and intelligent solution compared to traditional hardware. Overall, this work represents a promising step forward in healthcare technology, aiming for better patient outcomes and more efficient healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Model for the Detection of Plant Disease with Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Traditional machine learning methods like Support Vector Machines, Multilayer Perceptron Neural Networks, and Decision Trees have been used to tackle the problem of automatically identifying plant diseases. Nevertheless, the dominant methodology now centres on the utilisation of deep learning principles, specifically concentrating on Convolutional Neural Networks. The main objective of this work is to develop a deep learning model for the precise detection of plant diseases, leveraging advanced techniques in precision agriculture to enhance crop health monitoring and management. The 20640 photos in the plant village collection, which represent 15 classes and 3 species—potato, tomato, and pepper—are used to conduct the study. The proposed deep CNN model identified unhealthy leaves with 99% accuracy. The report concludes with a thorough review of the suggested scheme and the model's output. To determine the proper value of the hyperparameter, the number of epochs and learning rate are first adjusted. Lastly, the suggested model's accuracy surpasses that of previous deep learning models.

articleTitle: Person Re-Identification: A Retrospective Study, Recent Trends and Future Scope
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Person re-identification (Re-ID) searches several non-overlapping cameras for a person of interest. The development of deep neural networks combined with the increasing need for intelligent video surveillance has led to a huge surge in interest in the field of computer vision. This article highlights the state-of-the-art techniques used for person re-identification (reID), including the latest advancements and challenges. It outlines the different person re-identification datasets that are available in the literature, evaluates the effectiveness of the best techniques across a range of datasets, and clarifies the important restrictions on person re-identification, including the effects of changing environmental conditions and data limitations. Furthermore, the article points out the future research direction, focusing on creating more realistic datasets and designing robust algorithms that can effectively handle real-world conditions in order to drive the growth and development of re- ID technology.

articleTitle: Color Preservation of Lymphoblastic Cells Using Statistical Region Merging
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Cancer is named based on the organ or cell type where it originates, such as Colon Melanoma or skin melanoma. Lymphoma, a prevalent cancer in India, is characterized by the swelling of lymph nodes, which are crucial for infection defense. Accurate labeling and understanding of various cell components in microscopic images are essential for the development of automated cancer diagnosis systems. This research addresses the problem of segmenting microscopic images to identify homogeneous cell regions, which is vital for precise cancer detection. We deployed a Statistical Region Merging (SRM) technique to segment slide views into regions with consistent properties. The method was tested on a set of lymphoma and histopathological images to evaluate its generality. Experimental results demonstrate segmentation outcomes at various detail levels, highlighting the effectiveness of the technique. The segmentation coarseness was adjusted using the parameter <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$Q$</tex>, allowing for detailed and accurate identification of cell components.

articleTitle: Advanced Vibration Analysis for Predictive Maintenance in Wind Turbines
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This study offers a new way to assess the condition of high-speed bearings in wind turbines. The method uses basic data from sensors that detect vibrations. The method involves creating a Kurtosis Spectrogram for each of the 50 samples and using a 1D-CNN to sort the bearings into two categories: Medium-life Expectancy (more than 15 days) and Short-life Expectancy (less than 15 days). The study highlights the importance of finding problems early to better predict how much longer machine parts will last. This is important for avoiding breakdowns and improving maintenance plans. The 1D-CNN, built with Keras, shows great accuracy, reaching about 90% overall accuracy based on recall. This study highlights how this solution could be used in alert systems. It helps make important decisions about maintaining parts, making sure wind turbine systems work well and reliably.

articleTitle: Attendance Management System Using Geofencing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In institutions it is considered an important to teachers to be actively involved in the attendance process to facilitate knowledge transfer. One common approach is for teachers to manually sign an attendance sheet. However, a such sheets can easily be Lost. Moreover, relying on paper-based systems can lead to wasted time and hinder learning productivity in the classroom. While there are paperless attendance systems available, like Biometric or Android based solutions they often require hardware such as computers either RFID readers which can result in increased costs for both equipment and maintenance. Taking these factors into account our aim is to the tackle this issue by developing an attendance system that minimizes the need, for hardware and software requirements. We do this by improving the mobility of presenting attendance systems and leveraging both GPS and Geo Fence methods.

articleTitle: Seismic Safeguard Based on Intelligent System and Power Management
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This paper presents the hardware design and development of an intelligent seismic safeguard system using an Arduino Uno Microcontroller. A Square Haven for Earthquake Survival dimensions of life-saving box boasts a compact and sturdy design, measuring 21.5 inches on each side, crafted from durable wood for added resilience in harsh environments. Its compressed dimensions allow for informal stowage in various locations, offering a sense of security and preparedness. This system aims to enhance safety and survival chances during and after an earthquake by, mitigating accidental box opening the system utilizes a servo motor controlled by the Arduino to lock and unlock the box securely, preventing accidental opening due to tremors. Environmental monitoring movement detection vibration sensor-detects tremors and triggers the system. Automated rescue signal a GPS sensor integrated with the system transmits the box's location to emergency response teams, facilitating faster rescue efforts. The power management system employs to operate intelligent strategies to optimize battery life, ensuring prolonged operation during critical situations. It provides with survival supplies oxygen cylinder with mask, torch light, water bottle, food supplements while awaiting rescue during earthquake. Adult diapers maintain hygiene and sanitation during extended periods within the box.

articleTitle: Optimizing Melanoma Diagnostic Accuracy through Deep Learning and Attention Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This paper explores the application of multiple deep learning architectures for the detection of melanoma, a severe and potentially deadly form of skin cancer. Utilizing a sophisticated ensemble approach that integrates VGG-16, ResNet-50, and Vision Transformers, each model leverages unique strengths in image processing and feature recognition to enhance diagnostic accuracy. The study employs the ISIC dataset, enhanced through extensive data augmentation techniques to address class imbalance and increase model robustness. Our findings reveal that the ensemble model outperforms individual architectures, achieving an impressive accuracy of 93.54%, demonstrating the effectiveness of combining diverse computational strategies. Furthermore, the incorporation of the Convolutional Block Attention Module into VGG-16 significantly refines its capability to focus on critical dermatological features, suggesting that attention mechanisms can substantially improve the performance of convolutional networks in medical image analysis. The promising results signify the potential of advanced machine learning models to transform melanoma diagnostics, supporting their integration into clinical settings for better patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Evaluating Various Techniques for Twitter Sentiment Analysis for Election Results
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The Indian General Election of 2019 is proof of the rise in political content on social media platforms, reflecting user attitudes and behaviors towards the electoral process. This paper examines the collective behavior of Twitter users during the election period and assesses the feasibility of election prediction through social media analysis in India. This work presents weekly sentiment analysis on election-related Twitter content. It analyzes how social media content can be used as a reliable factor of public sentiment during elections and has recourse to be a predictive parameter alongside other factors. The simulation results show that VADER outperforms various state-of-the-art techniques with a mean absolute error of 1.345 for candidate-wise predictions, significantly outperforming Textblob (5.445), Pattern analyzer (5.135), and pre-trained BERT (28.335) while yielding similar results for party-wise and alliance-wise analyses.

articleTitle: Predictive Heart Guard: Using Support Vector Machines for Early Warning Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In this study, the predictive modeling employed is the support vector machine (SVM) method, which efficiently handles highly complex health data. Despite the prevalence of stressful lifestyles today, it seems unlikely that people in the past had significantly weaker hearts. Heart failure occurs when the heart fails to pump effectively. SVM helps predict who might be at risk of serious vascular issues by identifying potential problems before they arise. With an impressive 79% accuracy in classifying various clinical conditions and risk factors, SVM demonstrates its effectiveness. If used properly, such predictions could revolutionize healthcare by detecting heart issues early and potentially reducing costs. This research highlights the critical role of advanced computer methods in improving early detection and management of heart failure, leading to more effective health monitoring strategies.

articleTitle: Advanced Pothole Detection System: Leveraging CNNs for Safer Roads
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The goal of this project is to develop a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) [1]model for detecting potholes in images. The process involves collecting a diverse dataset of images with and without potholes, preprocessing the data to standardize image sizes and enhance feature representation, and designing a CNN architecture specifically for pothole detection. The model's performance is evaluated using standard metrics such as accuracy, recall, precision, and F1-score[1]. Postprocessing techniques generate binary images highlighting detected potholes and provide text messages indicating the presence or absence of potholes[6]. Iterative refinement through hyperparameter tuning ensures improved accuracy and generalization. This project aims to enhance road safety by automating pothole recognition, thereby facilitating timely maintenance and repair efforts.

articleTitle: Targeted Insights: Advanced Gradient Boosting Models for Accurate Obesity Risk Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Identifying obesity risk is crucial. In this study, comparing three machine learning models for detecting obesity risk revealed that the XGBoost classifier was the most accurate, with a 91% accuracy rate. In contrast, LightGBM and CatBoost models had slightly lower accuracies of 90%. These models could be valuable tools in identifying individuals at risk of obesity, facilitating preventive and personalized healthcare to address the increasing prevalence of obesity-related complications. The models utilize extensive datasets with diverse demographic and clinical characteristics, incorporating features such as Weight (0.38), Height (0.11), Age (0.10), Frequency of Vegetable Consumption (FCVC) (0.098), Gender (0.06), Technology Use Time (TUE) (0.045), Daily Water Consumption (CH2O) (0.045), Physical Activity Frequency (FAF) (0.036), Number of Main Meals (NCP) (0.031), Family History of Overweight (0.025), and several other factors. By analyzing these features, the models can detect subtle patterns that may signal obesity risk. This capability can enable healthcare providers to adopt tailored approaches for obesity prevention and management, potentially advancing public health. Accurate risk identification can lead to targeted preventive measures, starting with lifestyle changes and patient education and extending to pharmacological and technological interventions.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Markow Modeling with Trading Strategies for Efficient Stock Market Predictions
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Financial markets are considered the most chaotic and complex dynamic systems as factors responsible for the fluctuation of share prices are numerous and plentiful. Owing to the advancements in the field of machine learning and artificial intelligence the predictive nature of the stocks has been a topic of debate among researchers since then. From factors such as historical prices to technical indicators, the stock prediction needs a strategy that simply combines the present status with the indicators of the past time series data. In this work, we proposed a Hidden Markov strategy with the ability to determine the future state based on the present state and further combine these hidden states with the traditional moving average crossover strategy to develop a combined signal to classify the stock and depict timely buy, hold, or sell signals. Results indicate an improvement of the Sharpe ratio along with the higher returns when the combined signal is being used to make decisions.

articleTitle: A Novel Image Segmentation-Based Hemolysis Detection Method for Red Blood Cells
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Quantitative assessment of red blood cell (RBC) morphology and its membrane fragility has been a fundamental step in diagnosis of several diseases. Hemolysis refers to the breakdown of erythrocyte plasma membrane, and it occurs under a variety of physiological (in vivo), pathological and in vitro conditions. Accurate and timely detection of hemolysis is crucial for efficient diagnosis of hematological and cardiovascular diseases. RBC hemolysis has been traditionally assessed using spectrophotometric method, and manual counting of healthy cells using hemocytometer. However, such methods are extremely tedious and often require experienced experts for analysis and interpretation of slides. Therefore, a computer-based automatic counting and detection system may help improving the speed and accuracy of diagnosis in clinical settings. In this work, we proposed a novel morphometric-based quantitative framework that automatically detects and counts the number of healthy and lysed red cells in a given microscopic image that is obtained using light microscopy under specific condition. Microscopic image data of isolated red blood cells, subjected to isotonic, hypotonic and hypertonic stresses were analyzed using combined image pre-processing and segmentation techniques to quantify percentage hemolysis in a given image. The counting accuracy and performance of the present method were compared with that obtained using traditional hemocytometer method and specrtrophotometric method of hemolysis quantification. This study provides a simple image-based quantification of erythrocyte hemolysis for computer-aided diagnosis of blood disorders.

articleTitle: HBTrackr: AI-Based Heart Attack Prediction through ECG Monitoring on Wearable Devices
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The topic proposes the existence of various mobile applications designed to predict and detect abnormal heartbeats, providing individuals with an accessible tool for monitoring their cardiac health. Advancement in AI supports heart attack prediction which can be deployed in various smart applications. In the paper, a novel AI model is implemented to read the Electrocardiogram (ECG) of the patient and understand the heart health of the person by wearing a smart watch. The proposed framework focuses on detection of sudden cardiac arrest and prediction of abnormal heartbeat using You Only Look Once(YOLOv8) in the wearable devices. The model is trained on ECG images dataset of cardiac patients using a matrix of features such as myocardial infarction, irregular heart rhythms, and healthy cardiac patterns. The model achieves high precision, recall, and F1 score, demonstrating its effectiveness in accurately classifying cardiac conditions. HBTrackr is an easy-to-use smartwatch app which is incorporated with an AI model that uses the pre-existing sensors in the watch.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Connectivity: Unveiling Next-Gen Efficiency with 6G's Ultra-Reliable Low Latency Communications Resource Allocation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In the imminent era of 6G, this comprehensive review paper navigates the landscape of Efficient Resource Allocation in Ultra-Reliable Low Latency Communications (URLLC) with a particular focus on limitations and advancements in deep learning methodologies, specifically Deep-Q-Learning (DQL). As the demand for unprecedented connectivity experiences intensifies, the study addresses the challenges and opportunities associated with 6G URLLC, emphasizing the critical role of DQL in optimizing resource allocation. The paper critically evaluates the current state of DQL applications in URLLC, providing a nuanced understanding of its limitations in diverse scenarios. It explores the interplay between DQL and other resource allocation techniques, shedding light on synergies and potential areas for improvement. The limitations discussed include issues related to scalability, convergence, and adaptability to dynamic network conditions. Amidst the review of existing methodologies, the paper proposes potential enhancements to DQL, such as hybrid approaches integrating traditional optimization techniques, to overcome its limitations effectively. The study also highlights the importance of benchmarking and standardization in evaluating the performance of DQL-based resource allocation schemes, ensuring a fair comparison across different scenarios.

articleTitle: An Optimized SIMON Lightweight Image Encryption Algorithm for Internet of Things: Balancing Performance and Security
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The paper presents an optimized SIMON lightweight cryptographic algorithm that balances security, performance, and cost in contexts with limited resources. By lowering the computational cost and preserving strong security characteristics, the suggested changes make the algorithm appropriate for use in embedded systems, Internet of Things (IoT) devices, and mobile platforms. To improve encryption efficiency, changes have been made, such as fewer bit shift operations and the consolidation of bit-wise functions. A thorough evaluation process is applied to the updated algorithm, which involves calculating measures like information entropy, UACI (Unified Average Changing Intensity), and NPCR (Normalized Pixel Change Rate). Empirical findings show that the optimized SIMON algorithm significantly increases encryption efficiency and speed while maintaining the security of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Soil Analysis Using Deep Learning for Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This research explores the application of deep learning techniques for soil analysis in precision agriculture, focusing on the classification of soil types using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The study addresses the limitations of traditional soil classification methods, which are often labor-intensive and reliant on expert judgment. The proposed approach involves collecting soil image data, preprocessing it using techniques such as Gabor filtering, and classifying the images with a CNN model. The methodology includes data acquisition, feature extraction, and model training, aiming to accurately predict soil parameters using diverse input data sources like sensor readings and satellite imagery. The potential benefits of this approach include real-time monitoring, optimal fertilizer application, and enhanced crop management, which can contribute to sustainable agricultural practices and food security.

articleTitle: Perceptions and Impact of Blockchain Technology and Fintech: A Survey-Based Study
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Blockchain technology and fintech innovation are poised to revolutionise finance. Blockchain can decentralise trust, democratise access, and revolutionise processes, while fintech can drive innovation. However, scalability, regulation, and education must be navigated. The future of finance includes borderless finance, fluid assets, and trust becoming code. Ultimately, this research champions a future where fintech and blockchain transform finance for good, empowering individuals and fostering a more inclusive and secure financial ecosystem. The world is digitising, and finance is progressing with technological challenges. So, it is imperative to study Fintech and its impact. In this paper, the researcher tried to learn about the top fintech trends and how blockchain and fintech will shape the future of the financial services industry. Research Design: This research also consists of a survey which helps us better understand the general public's view on this topic and their opinion on the future of fintech and blockchain technology. The data collected from respondents helps us understand future trends and the fintech industry.

articleTitle: Identification of Sugarcane Leaf Diseases and Deficiency Disorders Using Transformers
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Early identification of plant diseases and nutrient deficiencies is crucial for ensuring healthy food production, especially for crops like sugarcane, which contribute significantly to our food supply. Farmers often struggle to differentiate between diseases and deficiencies due to similar symptoms. To overcome such challenges, this study leverages the application of transformers to classify whether the given input is suffering from disease or deficiency. For this purpose, two transformers, i.e., Vision Transformer (ViT) and Swin Transformer is trained on the dataset having leaves of sugarcane. The performance of the model is calculated in terms of precision, recall, accuracy and F-score. From the results, it is found that the Vision transformer with an accuracy of 99.6% can classify diseases and deficiencies more accurately compared to the 99.2% accuracy for Swin transformer.

articleTitle: Aqua Algorithms Enhancement of Water Quality Prediction with ML Bagging Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Ensuring the availability of clean water is crucial for sustaining life and enhancing public health. Accurate prediction of water quality parameters is vital for proactive water resource management and pollution control. We examine a broad range of water quality indicators, such as pH, dissolved oxygen, turbidity, and nutrient levels, across various regions. In this study, we employ bagging classifiers, a popular machine learning technique, to enhance the accuracy and reliability of our models. We anticipate achieving 76% accuracy with these classifiers. By utilizing different learning methods, including ensemble learning techniques like Bagging Classifiers, our research aims to improve water quality assessment. This work offers valuable insights for better environmental management and ensuring access to clean water for everyone.

articleTitle: OCTNet: Leveraging VGG16 for Automated Classification of Retina Health from OCT Scans
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The healthy vision is seriously threatened by retinal diseases include drusen, diabetic macular edoema, and choroidal neovascularization (CNV). Immediate identification and treatment are essential to reducing their effects and retain healthy lives. In this work, model provide a deep learning method based on the VGG16 architecture for the automatic identification of retinal injury using a dataset of retinal OCT (optical coherence tomography) pictures. retinal OCT images into these four categories by preprocessing the images and training a VGG16 convolutional neural network (CNN) model. The retinal OCT dataset is used to fine-tune the pretrained VGG16 model, which is well-known for its efficiency in image classification tasks, so that it can adjust to the unique properties of retinal pictures. By means of comprehensive testing, the model assesses the accuracy performance of the proposed model across several epochs. The suggested model improves validation accuracy from 87.89% to 92.01% and training accuracy from 97.22% to 100%. The findings show that the VGG16-based method is helpful in accurately detecting retinal abnormalities, providing ophthalmologists with a possible tool to help them diagnose retinal illnesses quickly and reliably. By offering a dependable and automated technique for identifying retinal damage from OCT pictures, this work advances computer-aided diagnosis tools for retinal illnesses and eventually advances early intervention and better patient outcomes and hence improve quality of life.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Flood Monitoring - A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Floods are a major natural disaster; it happens when a usually dry land is overflowed with water. The most common causes of floods are overflowed rivers or streams, heavy rainfall for a long period of time, a failed dam or a rapid ice melt in the mountains. Floods have a significant impact on the communities globally. It causes extreme damage to people, animals, and infrastructure. It affects agriculture causing damage to crops which results in food scarcity. Many people become homeless and have difficulties in sustaining their lives which hampers country's economic growth, leading to poor GDP (Gross Domestic Product). This paper provides a systematic review of work done in field of flood detection and avoidance mechanism using techniques such as Cloud computing (CC) (Saas (Software as a service), Paas (Platform as a service), Iaas (Infrastructure as a service), AWS (Amazon Web Service)), machine learning (CNN (Convolution Neural Networks), KNN (K-nearest neighbors)) and Internet of Things (IoT) [Sensors, NodeMCU, WSNs (Wireless sensor networks), WSANs (Wireless Sensor and Actuators Networks)]. CC is a scalable and secure platform where analysis and processing of real-time data can be done. This paper systematically examines the methodologies and technologies used along with the challenges that are associated with cloud-based flood monitoring system.

articleTitle: Optimized Low Weight CNN Concatenation Using Deep Curve Estimation for Low Light Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This paper outlined a Zero - DCE modification, termed as Zero-Reference Deep Curve Estimation, with primary focus on enhancing night time object recognition in surveillance footage. Our approach uses deep networks to estimate curves specifically for each image, redefining light enhancement. Specifically designed to tackle issues common in low-light situations, our method computes pixel-wise and high-order curves for dynamically altering the range of given images using a lightweight deep network called DCE-Net. Zero-DCE is notable for its minimal dependence on reference pictures, which eliminates the need for paired or unpaired data during training, setting it apart from conventional approaches. The non-reference loss functions, which are carefully constructed and implicitly measure enhancement quality and direct network learning, enable this breakthrough.

articleTitle: Next-Gen Speech Disorder Diagnostics: CNN Methods for Dysarthria Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Neurological disorders such as amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) and cerebral palsy (CP) are common causes of dysarthria, the subject of this research article. Dysarthria has a significant impact on communication capacity, making early diagnosis essential for effective therapies and improved patient outcomes. The research used a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to categorise speech using the TORGO database, which includes 2000 samples of individuals with and without dysarthria, representing different genders. There are 500 samples from each gender in the collection, representing dysarthric and non-dysarthric people who were recorded during different sessions. Highlighting the promise of deep learning technology in aiding early identification of dysarthria and enabling rapid therapy for affected individuals, the CNN-based approach exhibits an amazing 96% accuracy in discriminating between dysarthric and non-dysarthric cases. This study offers a promising chance to enhance the quality of life for those with speech impairments while also making substantial contributions to the development of diagnostic capabilities.

articleTitle: A Transformer Based Indian Signed Language Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Effective communication is essential to human interaction. The people with hearing and speaking disability primarily rely on Signed Language for communication. Each Sign Language has its own grammar and vocabulary. Individuals who can speak and hear proficiently often struggles to understand and respond to Sign Language gestures, creating a barrier to meaningful communication. This paper attempts to bridge the communication gap by using sophisticated deep learning models like transformers. INCLUDE is a dataset tailored for the Indian population, focusing specifically on Indian Sign Language. Our work involves breaking down videos into frames and employing image processing techniques. Furthermore, we utilize pre-trained models, such as VGG16, EfficientNet, and MobileNet, to extract latent embedding, which are then processed through Transformer network for classification. Hyperparameter tuning is used to optimize model performance. This allowed us to reach an accuracy of 92 % which is better than existing approaches. The proposed method was also tested on LSA64 dataset giving an impressive accuracy of 99.34%.

articleTitle: Blockchain Based Fake Product Detection System: Enhancing Supply Chain Transparency
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Supply chain management faces numerous challenges, such as service redundancy problems with interdepartmental coordination, and a lack of standardization that is made worse by a lack of transparency. Since traditional methods of detection, such as RFID tags, artificial intelligence, and QR code systems, have limitations, product counterfeiting is a serious threat to legitimate businesses. By tracking the products' supply chain history, the decentralized architecture, data transparency, and immutability of blockchain technology are used by the system in order to guarantee the identification and traceability of authentic products. This paper presents an innovative solution combining blockchain technology, QR codes, and machine learning to detect fake products effectively. The innate security characteristics of blockchain technology provide strong defense against data manipulation and vulnerabilities, protecting the interests of consumers and legitimate businesses.

articleTitle: Strategic Integration of Security Product Standard: A Comparative Study of Early vs. Late Implementation in Software Development
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Organizations engaged in development and shipment of software products must strike a balance between delivery of business requirements versus product standards. Implementation of product standards is crucial from development till realization phases of product development to derive maximum benefits it is essential that the product standards are incorporated during the initial stages of product development like design phase. In this paper an evaluation is carried out to highlight the significance of timely incorporation of product standards to ensure compliance. A methodology is proposed for incorporating product standards at various stages of the product life cycle. Later using the proposed model, a use case is illustrated to derive the pros and cons of incorporating product standards at various stages of product development.

articleTitle: Integrated Violence and Weapon Detection Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Detecting violence in public spaces is crucial for ensuring safety and security. While current methods primarily rely on body movement cues, they often struggle to identify instances like single-gunshot violence. In this study, an innovative approach is proposed to overcome this limitation by integrating weapon detection to enhance accuracy and reduce false positives. Drawing inspiration from recent advancements in deep learning, techniques such as feature extraction using pre-trained networks are leveraged. Our methodology involves the combination of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) for spatial feature extraction and long short-term memory (LSTM) networks for temporal relation learning. Additionally, the efficacy of integrating transformer-based models, such as the Vision Transformer, for enhanced feature representation is explored. Through comprehensive evaluation on diverse datasets, our approach demonstrates high accuracy while maintaining real-time processing speed. Comparative analysis against state-of-the-art methods reveals superior performance, achieving an accuracy of up to 98% and a processing speed of 131 frames/sec. This research significantly contributes to the enhancement of violence detection systems by addressing challenges related to accuracy, speed, and applicability across various video sources.

articleTitle: Transforming Household Waste Management: Design and Implementation of an IoT-Enabled Smart Dustbin System
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has revolutionized waste management by connecting physical objects, or “things,” embedded with sensors, software, and other technologies to exchange data over the Internet. This paper proposes an IoT -based Smart Dustbin for the Household, a revolutionary concept that aims to improve cleanliness and waste management within homes. This innovative system integrates various hardware components to optimize bin functionality, offering distinct portals for both the garbage company and users. The implementation of this innovative system includes ultrasonic and humidity sensors. The system enables real-time monitoring of dustbin fill levels and moisture levels, ensuring efficient waste disposal. Moreover, the system segregates trash into biodegradable and non-biodegradable categories, streamlining recycling efforts and promoting sustainability. The proposed system can be used to effectively monitor and manage waste accumulation.

articleTitle: Comment Compass: An Approach to Analyze YouTube Comments through Web Scraping, Sentiment Analysis, and Generative AI for Actionable Insights
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In this paper, we introduce “Comment Compass,” a novel system designed to revolutionize the analysis of YouTube video comments by content creators. The hypothesis driving this research is that integrating web scraping, sentiment analysis, and generative AI can provide content creators with deeper insights into their audience's sentiments and perspectives, thereby enhancing content strategy and engagement. Methodologically, “Comment Compass” employs Python-based web scraping to extract comments from YouTube videos. Sentiment analysis is conducted using the SentimentIntensityAnalyzer from the Natural Language Toolkit (NLTK) library, which produces a pie chart depicting the distribution of positive, negative, and neutral comments. Additionally, the system leverages Generative models to generate further insights from the comments, such as future content ideas, criticisms, and inquiries. Our results indicate that “Comment Compass” offers content creators actionable insights that can significantly optimize content strategies for better audience engagement and impact. This work demonstrates the substantial potential of combining web scraping, sentiment analysis, and generative AI, contributing valuable knowledge to these fields. The findings are contextualized within existing literature, underscoring the innovative contributions of this research.

articleTitle: Evaluating DDoS Detection and Mitigation in SDN at Various Attack Rates
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Software-Defined Networking (SDN) surpasses traditional network systems in terms of programmability, management, flexibility, and efficiency due to its distinct separation of data and control planes. The central management of devices is crucial in handling Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks, providing a comprehensive view of the network and the capability to analyze network traffic to detect malicious activity. Despite the advantages of separation of control and data planes, this architecture is susceptible to DDoS attacks, which pose challenges in real-time detection and resistance. Effective countermeasures against such attacks rely on carefully selecting features for attack detection. Our work focuses on detecting DDoS attack using ensemble Machine Learning (ML) techniques. Mitigation is done by trace backing approach to locate the source of attack. A thorough result analysis is done based on attack rate, detection time and mitigation time to test the ONOS Flood Defender Application for detection and mitigation of DDoS attack.

articleTitle: QUERY ME: An Interactive Personalize Discussion Forum for E-Learning and Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The persona of today's students has surged the need to use student learning techniques such as interactive self-directed learning in different ways. Interactive Personalize Discussion Forums (IPDF) are used as support tools to enhance interaction and teacher-student interaction. This study created an online forum called “Query Me” to promote educational discussion and communication exchange between students and teachers. “Query Me” will facilitate getting the most precise answer with the help of AI and improve communication and relationships between students and teachers. The discussion forum proposed in this study has proven to be of assistance in terms of teacher-student interaction, communication and conflict resolution, and collection of student information in schools/workplaces. Moreover, research confirms that online learning has increased student interest and participation in online forums.

articleTitle: Health Monitoring for a Person in a Manned Submersible
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This project pioneers a robust health monitoring system for individuals in Deep Sea Manned Submersibles, spanning both Human Occupied Vehicles (HOV) and Remotely Controlled Vehicles (RCV). Continuous health surveillance is paramount, with swift anomaly detection triggering rescue alerts. Our system surpasses previous models by leveraging real datasets for CNN algorithms and images for Pan Tompkins algorithms. Comparative evaluation of diverse algorithms, including Pan Tompkins and CNN, enhances arrhythmia detection and classification accuracy. Our hardware setup integrates an AD8232 sensor with an ESP32 running trained ML hex files, bolstered by a combined notch and low-pass filter for superior noise reduction. Additional SPo2, HR, temperature, and humidity sensors augment data collection. Real-time data transmission to a web server enables comprehensive analysis. This project underscores breakthroughs in machine learning and healthcare technologies, transforming remote health monitoring in extreme conditions.

articleTitle: Enhancing Harris Hawk Optimization for Use in Smart Building Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The paper proposes an enhanced Harris Hawk optimization model tailored for energy prediction in smart buildings and renewable energy systems. Leveraging advanced optimization techniques, the proposed model aims to accurately forecast energy consumption and generation, thus facilitating efficient energy management and resource utilization in sustainable infrastructures. The R-squared (R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) value of the proposed model is 0.9828, which clearly shows that it performs better than the existing optimization ML models.

articleTitle: Car Accident Insurance Claim Verification with Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The insurance industry has an extreme amount of burden of verifying the car insurance claims, which are done manually and hence the claim processes can become tedious both for the car owner and insurance company. It is known that machine learning and artificial intelligence are meant to benefit the people, aid them in their activities and help them do it more efficiently. So this paper describes a system that is designed with the help of Deep Learning which can aid the insurance companies in the process of claim verification by eliminating the process of a surveyor physically checking the car. The user can upload images of the number plate and damaged part of the car and can get their claim verified faster. The accuracies of both our models are: 75% for damage localisation and 68% severity detection.

articleTitle: Exploring Advanced Segmentation Strategies for Breast Cancer Detection: A Comparative Study of U-Net Variants and Ensemble Model
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Ultrasound imaging plays a crucial role in the detection of breast cancer, offering real-time visualization with high resolution and without ionizing radiation. Accurate segmentation of tumors from ultrasound images is essential for precise diagnosis and treatment planning. This study assesses the effectiveness of the basic U-Net architecture and its variants, which involve replacing the encoder with convolutional networks like ResNet50 and VGG16. Additionally, the study explores the ensemble of both models to further enhance breast cancer detection from ultrasound images. The advantage of ensemble learning lies in its ability to harness the strengths of individual models, thereby improving overall performance and robustness by mitigating weaknesses and uncertainties associated with any single model. In this study BUSI, a public dataset is used for experiments. Ensemble model performs better as compare to Resnet50UNet and Vgg16UNet.

articleTitle: Classification of Mental Workload Using 1D-CNN with Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Mental workload (MWL) can be explained as the ratio of a participant's mental effort to their brain capability when performing activities. A significant challenge in the field of MWL classification for brain-computer interfaces (BCIs) based on electroencephalograms (EEGs) is the variability among individuals. It commonly takes unnecessary time to retrain the classification model from starting for a new subject. To address the individual variations among different subjects, a one-dimensional convolutional neural network along with transfer learning (1D CNN-TL) is proposed in this work. The end-to-end 1D-CNN learns the common features of EEG signals and, to tackle the problem of difference in EEG for individuals, a transfer learning technique is used that does fine-tuning on fully connected (FC) layers for a new participant having less training data. The average test accuracy (mean±stdv) of 65.18± 8.37 is achieved over the Cross-session mental workload dataset. The suggested method can achieve satisfying results for new unknown data with less time and fewer training data.

articleTitle: Navigating Financial Complexity: The Role of a Tailored Finance Tracker Application for Small Businesses
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Effective financial management poses a persistent challenge in the ever-evolving landscape of small business. An innovative Finance Tracker Application has been developed for this study to tackle this hurdle. This innovative platform offers a rich array of tools, from a dynamic data visualization dashboard to real-time currency conversion, expense tracking, tax estimation, invoice generation, revenue projections, and intuitive exchange rate visualization. These robust features empower small businesses with the insights needed to make informed financial decisions, facilitating efficient management and sustainable growth. This application becomes an indispensable asset in navigating the competitive business landscape through user-friendly charts and strategic planning support, providing small businesses with a crucial edge.

articleTitle: Evaluating Reduced-Tag MRAM Architectures for Enhanced Performance in Last-Level Caches
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This paper evaluates the performance benefits of Spin-Orbit Torque Magnetic RAM (SOT-MRAM) and Spin Transfer Torque Magnetic RAM (STT-MRAM) in Last-Level Caches (LLCs) compared to traditional Static Random-Access Memory (SRAM). Architectural analysis reveals the superiority of emerging MRAM technologies in terms of area, latency, and leakage particularly for larger caches. The known dynamic energy performance gap in MRAMs is significantly narrowed by utilizing the reduced-tag technique, which yields improvements of approximately 9% and 2% in SOT-MRAM read and write operations, and 12% and 15% in STT-MRAM read and write operations, respectively. While this study provides a detailed architectural analysis, future research will focus on system-level modifications in cache replacement policies required to fully implement the reduced-tag technique.

articleTitle: Automatic Stress Recognition Using FACS from Prominent Facial Regions
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The Action Units (AUs), which show the muscular activity that causes transient changes in the facial expression, can be identified and scored with the use of the Facial Action Coding System. To distinguish between the two distinct emotional states of stress and neutrality, we propose a multilayer feedforward neural network (FFNN) and 17 AUs. The two benchmark facial expression datasets, CK + and DISF A, are used to implement the suggested work. Using the Openface tool, AU intensity levels were extracted from the input videos and organized into a matrix. FFNN then analyzes the AU intensity matrix to determine whether a pattern recognition job will be stress-free or neutral. The suggested work's prediction accuracy is 93.2%, which is far higher than the current feature-based approaches.

articleTitle: Canine Vertebral Column Segmentation Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The Canine Vertebral Column is the backbone that helps in the movements when doing various activities such as running, playing, digging, and other explorations. Spondylosis disease, which can be detected from Vertebral Column, may affect these activities. Therefore, segmentation of the Vertebral column from an X-ray image became a challenging task. This study employs deep learning to separate canine vertebrae from low-resolution radiograph images of dogs. Two models, UNet and U-Net++, are trained on the dataset evaluated using metrics such as Accuracy, Sensitivity, Dice Similarity Coefficient (DSC), and Jaccard Similarity Index (JSI). The dataset was obtained from the radiological image archive of the Department of Surgery and Radiology at the College of Veterinary Sciences, GBPUA&T, Pantnagar. It comprised more than 2000 analog X-ray images taken between 2002–2023 of dogs. The results are compared and analyzed. It is found that UNet++ performs well and yields visually better results compared to UNet.

articleTitle: Blockchain Security and Privacy using Machine Learning and Internet of Things-A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Technology connects the modern world. Countless endpoints, servers, infrastructures, and other services create a complex and fascinating cyber landscape that is always evolving, with new technologies being discovered every day and vulnerabilities being exposed. Blockchain, Internet of Things (IoT), and machine learning (ML) technologies have each developed strong answers to numerous cybersecurity issues in recent years. The creation of smarter safety devices that can automate tasks like resource allocation, anomaly or intrusion detection, and operational scalability has been made possible by ML and the IoT. Blockchain technology and ML both have advantages that can complement one another. While ML enables intelligent decision-making to identify anomalies, scalability, as well as effectiveness in Blockchain networks, blockchain delivers decentralized security and trust for the algorithms and data. This study demonstrates how blockchain technology and ML could work together to support 130 application cases pertaining to cybersecurity. Our research examines the present state of the art and explores cutting-edge advancements in blockchain security and privacy for IoT and ML, focusing on security aspects, challenges, and potential applications

articleTitle: ARIMA Model-Based Prediction of pH for Hydroponic Vertical Farm
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Hydroponics is a way of growing plants without soil, relies heavily on exact management of nutrient solutions, including maintaining optimal pH levels for plant growth. In this study, we explore the application of Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average (ARIMA) modeling to predict pH levels in hydroponic systems. The research leverages historical pH data collected from hydroponic setups to develop ARIMA models capable of forecasting pH trends. The study outlines the process of data preprocessing, including stationarity checks and differencing, followed by model selection and validation. The efficacy of the ARIMA models is evaluated based on performance metric root mean squared error (RMSE).

articleTitle: Data Mining Techniques to Enhance Reusability of O-O (Object-Oriented) Systems: A Systematic Review
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: There was a need to reduce the effort and time spent while developing software due to the quick evolution of the software industry. It is crucial to guarantee product quality while designing products and services to increase their market worth. Leveraging software reuse to achieve quality and productivity goals is advised. Reusability is a crucial measure that may be utilized to raise the overall level of software quality in less time and effort. To better understand the necessity of enhancing the reusability of O-O (Object-Oriented) systems, this study employed a semi-automated approach for measuring the values of class-level software metrics on input datasets collected from the MAVEN online repository. Even a comparative analysis of several data mining approaches for improving the reusability of O-O (Object-Oriented) software systems has been conducted in this paper based on performance parameters such as precision rate, MSE rate, and accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Designing an Intelligent Door Access System Utilizing Biometric NFC Bands and OTP Authentication Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The paper presents the development of an advanced door access control system that ensures both security and convenience. This comprehensive system includes various components such as microcontroller, RFID technology, display, buzzer, and GSM module. The core functionality revolves around the use of RFID technology, where data from the NFC band, including biometric information, is sent to a central microcontroller for authentication. Once authentication is complete, the system activates the output mechanism and provides real-time feedback to the user using a display and provides confirmation with an audible buzzer. Additionally, the project enhances security by incorporating an OTP-based method that requires users to enter a one-time password that is sent to their registered mobile device. Additionally, the integration of the GSM module enables remote access control, allowing administrators to manage permissions remotely via SMS or mobile app. This project combines cutting-edge technologies to create a robust and versatile access control system suitable for a variety of security applications.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Analysis of Various Deep Learning Based Multi Class Plant Disease Classification Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In modern agriculture, deep learning has become increasingly essential to identify plant diseases in the field of plant disease identification with leaf images, where convolutional neural networks (CNN) are garnering a lot of interest. Plant disease iden-tification and prevention are essential for producing healthy crops and maintaining farmers' livelihoods. This study uses leaf images to examine the effectiveness of deep learning (DL) algorithms for multi class plant leaf disease classification. The training data was expanded using data augmentation techniques, which eliminated the need for further image collecting. This paper uses three models namely InceptionV3, VGG16, and EfficientNetBO that have been compared using the plant Village data set. The three models that achieved the highest accuracy were EfficientNetBO (98.51 %), InceptionV3 (97.78%), and VGG16 (95.37%) for plant detection, and EfficientNetBO (97.58%), InceptionV3 (96.83%), and VGG 16 (94.35 %) for plant detection. Notably, EfficientNetBO performed better for disease classification than the other two algorithms. Farmers are able to take prompt action to stop the disease's spread and reduce crop losses since the technology can deliver fast and precise results.

articleTitle: Exploration of the Use of Conversational Text-Based AI Tools for Academic Teachers: A Use Case and Study
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The article explores the scope of integrating conversational AI (Artificial Intelligence) tools into the daily activities of academic teachers. The article presents a use case of adopting AI tools for performing some of the day to day, or regular activities of academic teachers. Today, AI is leveraged for multitude of activities including training robots to perform or mimic some human activities, processing large datasets to derive quick and intelligent decisions, and automating, or semi-automating some routine and repeated human tasks. Since 2021, conversational AI tools have witnessed huge amounts of usage activities from people across different industries. ChatGPT and Claude AI were used for prompt engineering to automate the use cases considered in this work and the results are presented in good detail. The accuracy and relevancy of ChatGPT and Claude AI outputs are good and this stands as a testament to the suitability of utilizing AI tools for some of the day-to-day activities of teachers.

articleTitle: AI Insights: Revolutionizing Mental Health Assessments Through Predictive Models
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This study looks at how machine learning can help understand mental health by using a big set of data that includes information about people's backgrounds, lifestyles, and social habits. The study uses a Boosting model, a Decision Tree Classifier, and a logistic regression model to carefully check how well each model works. The Boosting model had the best accuracy at 81. 75% The Decision Tree Classifier was next with 80. 69%, and the logistic regression model had 79. 63% Along with checking how well the model works, the research also uses methods to make it easier to understand and find important factors that influence mental health results. We used hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation to make sure the models are strong and can work well with different data. The results show that the suggested models can successfully find people who might be at risk for different mental health issues. Looking at which features are most important can help doctors understand things better and support the creation of new treatment plans in behavioral medicine. AI models could help connect lifestyle habits to high stress levels. This study wants to improve how we use AI to check mental health and show how important using data is for solving social and health problems.

articleTitle: Intercepting the Invisible: Monitoring and Analyzing Suspicious Web Threat Interactions
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The article Intercepting the Invisible Monitoring and Analyzing Suspicious Web Threat Interactions delves further into the topic of surveilling and analyzing hidden cyber dangers that exist throughout the internet. This article explores the approaches and technologies that are essential for detecting and keeping tabs on suspicious activity, even when they manage to elude conventional security procedures. This study seeks to reveal the complex network of hostile connections by using sophisticated monitoring methods and analytical frameworks. This will help throw light on the covert strategies used by cyber adversaries. our method may protect digital ecosystems from possible breaches and data compromise by actively detecting and reducing new risks via empirical research and case studies. Our research helps improve cybersecurity practices by shedding light on the dynamic nature of cyber threats and offering practical solutions to strengthen defenses.

articleTitle: Robustness Analysis of RSGBWPSO Algorithm over Noisy Objective Functions
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Metaheuristic Algorithms' (MAs) ability in dealing with noisy objective functions is very important for their usability in practical situations. Optimization algorithms experiences problem caused by noisy environment which added uncertainties. Researchers gets attracted by intrinsic flexibility and perturbations to these algorithms because of their inherent adaptability and flexibility in practical situations. In this paper a novel method, namely Range Selection Global Best-Worst Particle Swarm Optimization (RSGBWPSO), is proposed that splits the search space and uses optimal partitions selectively to ensure noise resilience and optimization performance. The RSGBWPSO algorithm balances exploration and exploitation inside the search space to optimize ranges and divides the total population with strategy to increase the quality of the global solution. Furthermore, by including range selection and repeated exploration-exploitation strategies, the suggested algorithm overcomes the drawbacks of MAs, including algorithmic delay and premature convergence. The goal of these improvements is to raise the general caliber of the algorithm's produced global solutions. Experiments on the Generalized Moving Peaks Benchmark (GMPB) functions verify the stability of RSGBWPSO and demonstrate its ability to consistently traverse through noisy settings and converge to optimal solutions. The outcomes show that RSGBWPSO is a dependable optimization technique that may be applied to resolve difficult and unclear optimization issues that emerge in real-world circumstances.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Alzheimer's Disease Identification: A Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: A brain disorder, Alzheimer's disease (AD), impacts the lifestyle of around 6.5 million people around the globe, generally people over 65, which causes advanced cognitive dete-rioration. Despite the complex and comprehensive research, no such cure exists till now, accentuating the strong necessity for early diagnosis and interventions. We examine how the role of biomarkers, like MRI and genetics, can play a massive role in early detection and how Data Science and Machine Learning can be used to enhance diagnostic accuracy. Advanced techniques like convolutional neural networks (CNN) and hybrid deep learning algorithms are used for identifying and detecting AD.

articleTitle: Sound Wave Scribe: Bridging Spoken Language and Written Text
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
