abstract: The Sound Wave Scribe Voice Assistant paper is, about how people interact with computers. It uses the advancements in natural language processing (NLP) and machine learning (ML) to incorporate voice commands. Inorder to rely on the intelligence when a user talks to the system, the assistant picks up the sound through a microphone or other input tools. The raw sound goes through steps like reducing noise breaking it into segments and extracting features. Then the system changes the sound into text using speech recognition (ASR). Different NLP components like tokenization part of speech tagging and named entity recognition break down the text into parts. After that the system figures out what users want by analyzing the text. Natural language understanding (NLU) figures out what users are saying while context management ensures transitions in conversations. Depending on what users want the system creates responses that sound human like using natural language generation (NLG) techniques. Dialog management keeps track of context and knowledge graphs offer data for answers. Finally computer generated speech–made using text to speech (TTS) libraries–turns the responses back, into sounding spoken words. The systems flexibility goes beyond setting reminders and scraping the web. You can do it all with voice commands. With connections, to databases and online platforms the Sound Wave Scribe Voice Assistant steps up user ease becoming a resource, for voice activated tech.

articleTitle: Implementation Of An Efficient Randomized Lightweight Stream Cipher RRSC 128-AEAD
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: A cutting-edge tool in cryptography, the RRSC-128AEAD stream cipher ensures that transmissions are secure and authentic. Using a 128-bit key and nonce combination, it effectively manages cryptographic inputs. The special capacity of RRSC-128AEAD to generate two distinct pseudo-random bit streams-one for encryption and the other for authentication-sets it apart. In contrast to other ciphers such as GRAIN-128AEAD, RRSC-128AEAD exhibits superior performance in key reintroduction and key leak prevention. The dual-stream mechanism of the cipher, in which one stream manages encryption and the other authentication, is what gives it its power. Its defense against possible threats is strengthened by this additional layer of complexity, which makes it difficult for attackers to compromise both streams at the same time. Additionally, because RRSC-128AEAD has a huge internal state space, attackers will find it difficult to break the code by trying a lot of different key combinations. Because RRSC-128AEAD can handle variable-length data, it is adaptable to a variety of cryptographic requirements. To prevent side-channel assaults, it also employs a masking approach to conceal patterns in its internal state. The cipher ensures the security of sensitive data by performing well in key reintroduction circumstances and reducing the chance of key leakage. RRSC-128AEAD shows up as a dependable and flexible option for safeguarding data in a variety of applications and securing communications as cyber security develops. Further, this methodology has been written in verilog for different versions and is simulated in Xilinx Vivado software.

articleTitle: Enhancing Human Pose Estimation: A Data-Driven Approach with MediaPipe BlazePose and Feature Engineering Analysing
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Computer vision has seen a surge in interest and research on human activity recognition using pose estimation techniques. It aims to classify the poses of human body joints via images and videos. Human Pose estimations work on 2D and 3D skeleton-based action recognition of human body landmarks, tailored explicitly to real-time on-device inferences. The study investigated the core components of the MediaPipe architecture, analysing mechanisms for keypoint detection, part affinity field generation, and real-time processing. It follows a two-step ML pipeline estimator and detector for pose estimation; the estimator directly computes key points for faster inference, whereas it utilises the skeleton-based approach for detecting, leveraging the topology of 33 landmarks derived from BlazePose. First, our model implements the BlazePose lightweight pose estimation convolutional neural network on IntelliRehabDS-IRDS, a rehabilitation dataset in which Kinect motion sensors record gestures. The key points explored in this paper's specific research include (1) Identifying human activities by detecting specific vital points and assessing the accuracy of their movements, which have been empirically shown to produce reliable outcomes to help enhance overall effectiveness. (2) t-Distributed Stochastic Neighbor Embedding and Principal Component Analysis is utilised to visualise data in 2D and 3D space, preserving 96.57% of the total explained variance. Feature_importance is used for feature selection: HandTipRight_3y 0.035, HandLeft_3y 0.02, and so on.

articleTitle: Android Based Malware Detection Technique Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The threat landscape has drastically become immense due to the increasing number of Android devices and applications. Android malware detection is an area of research that has seen increased importance due to the limitations of the traditional detection technique, which mainly relies on signature scanning, considering the rapidly changing malware nature. The paper aims to assess the efficiency of machine-learning techniques in augmenting the detection and identification of Android malware. A comprehensive framework is proposed which relies on the use of machine learning (ML) algorithms for analyzing and identifying malicious apps. The framework works on the database having a wide range of features extracted from Android applications, including Permission Features, System Features, Security-related Features, Communication Features, Data Access Features, App Lifecycle Features, Device Control Features, and Miscellaneous Features. Models’ performance is assessed using different metrics like accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, ROC AUC. The results show that most models achieve high detection rates with minimal false positives. Random Forest and XGBoost emerged as the top performers, achieving perfect scores of 1.0000 across all metrics.

articleTitle: Multi-Agent Based Social Interaction Model for Neurological Disorder
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Neurological disorders rooted in cognitive impairments can have a profound impact on the cognitive and brain developmental functions of children resulting in persistent cognitive disabilities. We proposed a multi-agent-based social interaction model designed for addressing neurological disorders. The paper establishes a foundation by presenting background information and articulating the motivations behind the study as well as presenting the incorporation of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) with Machine Learning (ML) and Deep Learning (DL) algorithms to develop an interpretable diagnosis and support system for a child with neurological disorders (referred as ND subject in this paper), in a real time social interaction environment. This model not only exhibits potency but is also distinguished by its interpretability and accountability. By integrating various agents and employing suitable AI techniques, proposed model provides advantages that can be harnessed across various aspects of neurological disorders, enabling informed decision-making. The proposed MAS-based model, enriched with multimodal data, promises a deeper understanding of the underlying mechanisms of cognltive-based neurological disorders.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Hand Gesture Evaluation Model to Control Media Player Using IoT Based Elevated Deep Learning Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In the modern world, instant engagement with complex structures that guarantee a quick response is the preferred method of communication for everyone. As a result, due to the ever-increasing advancements in technology, the problems that arise include reaction time and the simplicity of operations. Interaction between humans and computers comes into play at this position. The keyboard and mouse are the input devices that are being utilized, and this interaction is unlimited and presents a challenge to them. Recently, there has been a lot of focus placed on gesture detection. Instinctive gestures are an integral part of everyday interactions and are often used. The use of gestures to communicate with computer systems is therefore a completely new trend in the realm of interaction. Our program's objective is to provide a natural, device-free interface that can recognize hand gestures as commands. Its goals and aims are to utilize this interface. During the process of picture acquisition, the program makes use of a webcam. The program's main emphasis is on the most used features of VLC, such play, pause, and stop. It employs predefined gestures to control the media player, and with the help of the Internet of Things, it passes the collected gesture signals to the player. Elevated Learning for Hand Gesture Detection (ELHGD) is the name given to the suggested system that is employed in order to accomplish the aforementioned objective. This system is built on decision fusion and makes use of deep learning architectures. The effectiveness of the suggested technique is evaluated by comparing it to a traditional method known as Modified Hand Gesture Identification (MHGI). This is done in order to cross-validate the proposed idea. For the purpose of managing the VLC player, this hand gesture recognition technology will not only eliminate the need to use a mouse, but it will also give a variety of gesture vocabulary that will be helpful in controlling the program.

articleTitle: Towards the Development of eXplainable Digital Twins for Precision Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Precision agriculture practices involve deploying the sensors in agricultural farms, to collect data about various factors responsible for crop growth and development. Recently this sensor data is used for generating a virtual replica of the corresponding agricultural physical asset (crop, farm, etc.) called the digital twin (DT). The DT primarily collects data about the current state of a physical asset through sensors. A Deep Learning (DL) model underlying a DT processes this data and generates recommendations. The DL algorithms are, however, often perceived as ‘black-boxes’, which has led to the development of eXplainable artificial intelligence (XAI) approaches. Also, the DL algorithms are limited to generating predictions based on the past data, which can be easily countered by the real-time change tracking capability of the DTs. Therefore, in this work we propose a novel framework of eXplainable Digital Twins (XDTs), which leverages the strengths of both XAI for DL algorithms and the real-time responsiveness of the DTs. Further, we feel that DL algorithms requires huge volumes of data for training and model development. In agricultural domain, where a number of domain experts (like, a farmer has lots of experience about crops, etc.) are involved, we feel this data hungriness limitation of the DL models can be removed by complementing the sensor data with qualitative inputs of the domain experts. Therefore, we also propose (a possible framework) Enhanced XDTs (EXDTs), which use the domain experts' qualitative data, satellite & meteorological data as well as the generated explanations from the XDTs to generate (better) explanations and also suggest necessary state changes to the corresponding agricultural physical asset. We feel our proposed framework is useful for the involved stakeholders in precision agriculture and can be used in other domains as well.

articleTitle: Exploring the Role of Internet of Things in Wireless Sensor Networks for Industry 4.0 Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Recent developments in computer networking have made it possible to access information from a faraway location via either wireless or wired networks. The recent advancements in wireless infrastructure are directly responsible for the advent of wireless sensor networks, often known as WSNs. These networks make it easier to keep track of environmental happenings and activities, as well as document them and manage them. In WSNs, data relaying is accomplished through the use of a variety of routing strategies. Industry 4.0, also known as the fourth industrial revolution, is characterized by the incorporation of highly developed physical automation systems. These systems are made up of several pieces of machinery and gadgets that are linked together by sensors and are operated by software. The goal of the fourth industrial revolution is to improve the effectiveness and dependability of business processes. The Internet of Things (IoT) can be leveraged in manufacturing, which gives a means of linking engines, power grids, and sensors to the cloud in an industrial context. This is accomplished through the use of Industrial IoT. The purpose of this paper is to gain an understanding of how the Internet of Things functions in wireless sensor networks and its possible applications in a variety of settings.

articleTitle: Spatio-Temporal Data Analytics for Intelligent Transportation Systems: An Overview
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This study addresses the significance of spatio-temporal data analytics in Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), the various sources of spatio-temporal data, and the different technologies used to deploy ITS. It examines the body of research, points out shortcomings, and talks about new developments in the machine learning techniques for ITS. It discusses a variety of state-of-the-art methods used for data analytics in ITS. Following a study of the most recent research, we also list and evaluate the primary challenges faced in ITS. Future directions for ITS research and various ITS applications are also covered in this study. The paper addresses the challenges of security, privacy, and scalability while processing and analyzing massive amounts of spatiotemporal data. The potential of ITS to enhance sustainability, safety, and efficiency of transportation systems is also covered in this study.

articleTitle: Inventory Optimization of Multi-Echelon Supply Chain Under Market Uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Efficient inventory management is crucial for businesses operating within complex supply chain networks, especially when facing unpredictable and fluctuating customer demands. Maintaining meticulous control over inventory levels is paramount for ensuring the sustained success of the enter-prise. The article presents Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL) algorithm to optimize inventory management within complex supply chain networks. The focus is on utilizing policy based DRL algorithm, namely, Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) models to handle uncertain demands and unpredicted lead times. Experimental results demonstrate the superiority of the PPO model through consistent profit escalation considering both deterministic and stochastic demand scenarios as compared to classical inventory policies. Findings indicate that the average profit of the PPO model increases by 14% and 63% to DQN and classical (s, S) inventory policy. The comprehensive approach outlined in the article will contribute to a deeper understanding of how these methods perform under different conditions and provide valuable insights for efficient inventory management strategies in market uncertainties.

articleTitle: Imbalanced Classification of Cultural Heritage Images Using Deep Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: We investigate the use of deep learning in cultural heritage image classification when the number of samples is not uniformly distributed among the classes. Two intuitive methods, data resampling and transfer learning, are considered to address the impact of the imbalanced dataset. Results show that classification performance can be improved by using the two methods. Compared with the baseline convolutional neural network, the overall F1 scores computed over all classes show slight improvements of 2.67% and 4.56% for the data oversampling and transfer learning methods. However, when the per-class F1 scores are considered, the upgrades can be as high as 64.77% and 67.35% for the data oversampling and transfer learning methods, respectively.

articleTitle: Empirical Evaluation of a Cybersecurity Powered Human Body Data Communication over Wireless Body Area Network
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: All contemporary, user-friendly electronics necessitate technologies that allow for close-range communication between humans and other devices. In this paper, we show how to build and deploy a Human Area Network, which allows us to communicate with one another face-to-face. It is now crucial for mobile terminals to communicate with terminals embedded in the environment. The usage of wires is cumbersome since they often become tangled and are a pain to maintain when communicating between nearby devices. Data rates are lowered in congested settings, such exposition grounds, when extremely weak radio signals are utilized for communication due to packet collision. Additionally, unauthorized signal interception poses a security concern. In order to solve these kinds of challenges, we employ the human body as a means of communication. Cybersecurity Powered Human Data Communication (CPHDC) is a new communication logic introduced in this paper that uses the Red Tacton device to achieve threat- and error-free communication. To test how well it works, it is cross-validated with Frequential Band based Data Communication (FBDC), a conventional communication scheme. Using wearable devices for identification and data transmission to the master device in real time, the suggested model offers a safe and efficient communication system. With its integrated CPU and insulating material (copper) that enable intra-body communication through galvanic coupling, the suggested model is easily worn on the wrist or any other area of the body. Therefore, in comparison to existing wireless technologies, the suggested human body approach improves the security of sent signals.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Evaluation of Fake Face Recognition Scheme using Artificial Intelligence Oriented Learning Scheme
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Fake face recognition has emerged as a critical area of research due to the proliferation of synthetic media and its potential misuse in various domains. This study presents a thorough evaluation of a novel Fake Face Recognition Scheme utilizing Artificial Intelligence Oriented Learning Scheme (AIOLS) coupled with Generative Adversarial Network (GAN)-GoogleNet integration. The aim is to discern authentic facial images from synthetic or tampered ones with high accuracy. In this research, we employed a dataset comprising a diverse range of authentic and synthetic facial images. The proposed scheme incorporates the power of GANs for generating synthetic facial images and leverages GoogleNet, a state-of-the-art deep convolutional neural network, for discriminative feature extraction. The integration within the AIOLS framework facilitates efficient learning and adaptation to complex patterns present in fake facial images. The evaluation of our scheme was conducted through rigorous experimentation on the dataset, employing various performance metrics. Notably, the accuracy obtained was measured at an impressive 96.7%, signifying the effectiveness of our approach in distinguishing between real and fake facial images. Additionally, other metrics such as precision, recall, and F1-score were also computed to provide a comprehensive assessment of the scheme's performance.

articleTitle: System Dynamics Modeling for Understanding the Adoption of Digital Therapeutics
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Digital Therapeutics (DTx) is an expanding category of healthcare technologies utilising evidence-based software programs to treat, manage, or prevent illnesses and afflictions. The rise of DTx signifies a substantial transformation in the healthcare industry, providing cutting-edge remedies for managing, treating, and preventing diseases using software-based treatments. Nevertheless, the implementation of DTx encounters various obstacles driven by an intricate legal, technological, economic, and behavioural interaction. This study utilises System Dynamics Modelling (SDM) to examine the complicated dynamics that impact the adoption of DTx. The model showcases the interaction between these elements over time, illustrating how they affect the rate and extent of DTx adoption by simulating different situations. The model also examines the effects of potential legislative interventions, technological advancements, and strategic collaborations within the business to overcome barriers to adoption. This study offers a thorough overview of the adoption landscape, providing valuable information for developers of DTx, health care policymakers, and stakeholders who aim to fully use the potential of DTx in enhancing patient outcomes and transforming healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: A Survey on Recent Developments in Software Vulnerability Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In recent years, the rise of cyber threats and attacks has led to significant financial losses for software industries and individuals worldwide. Early detection of software vulnerabilities is crucial for mitigating future monetary risks. As a result, deep learning methodologies, such as pre-trained models, graph neural networks, transformer-based models, convolutional neural networks, and recurrent neural networks, have gained prominence for their ability to learn features and respond to new data. This paper provides a detailed discussion of recent deep learning methodologies for software vulnerability detection, delving into their approaches, limitations, and employed metrics. The key findings of the review highlight the predominant focus on the National Vulnerability Database, and similar repositories of open-source code, potential challenges in performance when confronted with real-world data, the limited scope of research on types, and the opportunity for exploring multilingual vulnerability detection methodologies.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition Systems: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Recently, emphasis has been placed on the applications of ISL since they assist people with HIs in their day- to-day lives in diversely populated India. This review paper aims to present years of development in real-time ISL recognition systems, the progress they brought, the issues they face, and the other ways it is being utilized in this ever-evolving area. We critically review the approaches for real-time ISL recognition from two aspects – the method and the assessment procedure based on the literature survey and recent developments and tendencies in the ISL research field. The current review accrues previous literature research to identify critical deficits and future suggestions to enrich the literature on assistive technologies for the deaf and hard-of-hearing people in India.

articleTitle: A Federated Learning Using Probabilistic Data Structures
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In this era, most of the prominent organizations are developing the chat-bots like Gemini and GPT and humanoid robots such as Ameca and Sophia. They have their capability to think and make their own independent decisions based on their extreme learning models. The data used to train these models is gathered from various sources in different formats. Federated learning is one of techniques using which the heterogeneous devices having non-identical independent data collaborate to train a global learning model without compromising with their privacy. In this case, the traditional data structures are not efficient enough to work on this real time big data, thus probabilistic data structures come into a picture which shows their feasibility to generate the result of queries within a stipulated time and space. This work aims to give an extensive overview of various probabilistic data structures and federated learning. The field of federated learning is fully investigated, covering its characteristics, classifications, challenges, evolution, and applications, along with research gaps. The primary goal of this work is to present a thorough overview of federated learning to readers and scholars who want to dive deeper into the topic, as well as possible future paths for research in this area.

articleTitle: Mental Health Detection Based On Hybrid Ensemble Stacking Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Undoubtedly, mental health exerts a profound influence on various aspects of human existence, spanning personal, familial, educational, societal, and even national domains. Our objective lies in the identification and provision of tools to individuals for the classification of mental health disorders, thereby mitigating the risks associated with misdiagnosis. This study employs a hybrid ensemble stacking methodology, amalgamating diverse classifiers to yield an optimal solution for mental health detection. The ensemble includes Gradient Boosting, Ada-Booster, K Nearest Neighbor classifier, Decision Tree, Multi-Layer Perceptron, Logistic Regression, and Support Vector Machine algorithms. The experimental setup is conducted on the Google Colab online platform. Our proposed model involves the conversion of the ‘Treatment’ column into binary values, where 'Yes' is represented as 1 and ‘No’ as 0. The dataset is partitioned into training (70%) and testing (30 %) subsets. Evaluation of the model on the test dataset reveals an accuracy of 82.80 %, precision of 94.30 %, recall of 77.12%, and f1-score of 84.85%.

articleTitle: Smart Toll System with Theft Detection Using Tesseract
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: All toll booths on highways are manually operated, with an attendant taking the driver's payment. We frequently experience gridlock at the toll booths on congested highways because this procedure can be slow. Time, effort, and human resources will be saved by automating the toll collection process. In this work, we propose a low-cost and effective method for collecting tolls called Smart Toll Collection using Automatic Number Plate Recognition (ANPR) that automatically recognises the vehicle's number plate after applying various pre-processing techniques to the input image of the car. The number plate could then be masked and segmented out either by detecting contours or by using the CNN, after which it could be recognised using Tesseract (OCR). When they pass through the toll plaza, the toll will be deducted from the account of the owner. Additionally, the owner will be informed that the vehicle entered the toll plaza at the specified time. We also assume that the owner keeps an electronic wallet, so that tolls are automatically deducted from the account at the toll booth upon identification of that specific licence plate. The shortcomings of the current manual and semi-automatic RFID system can be resolved by using this method of toll collection. This toll collection procedure will save time, effort, manpower and enhanced security features.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques for Social Media-Based Stress Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: With the rapid replacement of spoken communication by text-based modes, recent developments in digital technology have enabled analytical research for stress detection based on social media textual inputs. Nevertheless, there is a dearth of publicly accessible benchmarks. By combining two top-notch datasets derived from Reddit and Twitter, were able to accomplish our aim of stress detection using social media texts. There are three primary benefits: 1) describe in detail collected, preprocessed, and extracted features from each dataset; 2) compare the results of various DL (Deep Learning) and (Machine Learning) ML-based methods namely SVM (Support Vector Machine), CatBoost (Categorical Boosting), RNN (Recurrent Neural Network), RF (Random Forest), BNB (Bernoulli Naive Bayes), LR (Logistic Regression), CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) and DT (Decision Tree) using these datasets as a new standard in a field; 3) evaluate performance of these models in terms of F1-score, recall, accuracy, and precision. The ML-based decision tree model gets 95% accuracy that higher than other models. Models based on ML perform better than Deep-based techniques, according to extensive trials.

articleTitle: Multiview Learning and Decision Fusion Based Ensemble to Predict Anti-Cancer Peptide
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The spread of a life-threatening disease such as cancer presents a significant threat to the entire global population. The disease in question caused 10 million deaths worldwide in 2020, which has motivated us to explore innovative methods for treating cancer. Although numerous pharmaceutical solutions are accessible, they often have a hefty price tag and can adversely affect human cells. Anticancer peptides are a recently emerging field in cancer diagnosis, as they have a low likelihood of causing adverse reactions. The current study proposed using a multiview and decision fusion approach with stacking ensemble learning to predict anticancer peptides. Multiview learning and decision fusion is an emerging deep learning technique that enhances performance by integrating information from multiple views. Finally, the present work uses three 1-D conventional neural networks as the base classifier and a neural network as the meta-classifier to create a stacking ensemble for anticancer peptide prediction. The proposed ensemble scores a classification accuracy of 95.38%, an MCC value of 0.843, and an AUC score of 0.961 on a standard ENNAACT anticancer dataset, surpassing the performance of state-of-the-art approaches.

articleTitle: Explainable Artificial Intelligence For Pseudo Social Media Profile Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Due to the increasing frequency of fake profiles and their detrimental effects, which include spreading rumors and fa-cilitating identity theft, social media platforms like Instagram and Twitter are having a greater and bigger impact on people's lives. This study presents hybrid machine learning models like Deep Neural Network-Support Vector Machine (DNN-SVM), Long Short-Term Memory-Support Vector Machine (LSTM-SVM) and Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) achieving high accuracy that detect fake accounts on social media platforms, ensuring online integrity and security. These models have attained an accuracy of 99% on Twitter dataset, and 96% on Instagram dataset. Along with this, to address the lack of explanation capabilities in existing detection systems, explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques such as SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) values and Local Interpretable Model-agnostic Explanations (LIME) methods are incorporated. In the Instagram dataset, critical features included userFollowerCount, userFollowingCount and user-MediaCount, while statuses_count, favourites_count, geo_enabled and lang_num emerged as influential features in the Twitter dataset. The goal of this study is to detect fake social media accounts and provide transparency and understanding regarding the rationale behind machine learning predictions by elucidating the decision-making processes of the models, aiming to instill confidence in their outcomes and facilitate informed decision-making in real-world applications.

articleTitle: Alzheimer's Disease Detection and Classification: A Survey
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease stands as a progressive irreversible neurodegenerative issue affecting the mind, marked by cognitive decline and memory impairment. It is the most prevalent form of dementia globally, contributing significantly to dementia cases worldwide. The condition occurs through the collection of unusual protein aggregates like beta-amyloid plaques and tau tangles in the brain, disrupting cell level function and communication in brain neurons. This leads to a gradual decline in cognitive abilities, encompassing memory, language, problem-solving, and judgment. In the area of medical diagnostics, various machine-learning models are deployed to detect different stages of Alzheimer's disease. These methods include Transformers, Random forest, Recurrent Networks, and Convolutional Networks etc. Their purpose is to recognize and categorize the disease's progression, aiding in early diagnosis and intervention. Evaluating the performance of these models involves utilizing diverse datasets such as the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative and the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies. The reported accuracy ranges from 77 % to 99 %, showcasing the efficacy of machine and deep learning models in medical applications. These results highlight how important machine learning is to the medical field. By leveraging advanced computational techniques, researchers can enhance disease detection, prognosis, and treatment planning, ultimately improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Challenges and Opportunities in Digital Image Watermarking
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Image tampering is so simple in this era of digital revolution; digital image authentication presents a big difficulty. Digital image watermarking is a pivotal technique for protecting intellectual property rights and ensuring the authenticity and integrity of digital images. This paper explores the myriad challenges and opportunities associated with digital image watermarking. Despite significant advancements, challenges such as robustness against various attacks, maintaining image quality, and developing efficient and secure algorithms persist. The paper delves into these challenges, highlighting the technical hurdles and the ongoing need for innovation in algorithm design and implementation. On the other hand, it also underscores the opportunities that lie ahead with emerging technologies like artificial intelligence, machine learning, and blockchain, which possess the capacity to transform watermarking techniques. Furthermore, the integration of watermarking with evolving multimedia applications and digital rights management systems opens new avenues for research and development. By addressing these challenges and leveraging the opportunities, digital image watermarking can continue to evolve, providing more robust, efficient, and secure solutions for the digital era. This article provides a thorough analysis of the frameworks of popular watermarking systems, diving into their subtleties. It also offers an assortment of common requirements used in the creation of watermarking techniques for various uses. This paper also examines the latest advancements in digital image watermarking methods, including the benefits and drawbacks of each. The paper also examines many traditional attacks on watermarking systems and talks about possible directions for future study.

articleTitle: Lora-Based Data Transmission System for Smart Buildings
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The necessity of ease and convenience for users, a Smart Building with complex applications needs to be operated through a centrally automated system such that the data can be transmitted over a long range. Hence, a Long-Range Technology is needed to extend the low-power communication standard of an effective range of 13–15 Km with coverage across the entire city using a single Long Range (LoRa) gateway. Presently, developing countries use cellular technologies such as 3G, LTE, and 5G, but these technologies have their limitations because of their less coverage and high power consumption. Therefore, this paper aims to compress LoRa data before transmission to the LoRa gateway using deep learning method. Also, Channel-Net is trained to represent the noise in the channel. A Deep Neural Network (DNN) architecture is required to compress and decompress the LoRa data. Moreover, in the spectrogram analysis of the chirps, the LoRa technology is used to differentiate different device signals. The results show an error in the compression-decompression Auto Encoder and the classification of devices.

articleTitle: Diagnosing Cardiac abnormalities from PCG Using Raw Waveform Driven STFT Layered Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This paper explores the application of deep neural networks (DNN) for diagnosing cardiac abnormalities by analyzing phonocardiogram (PCG) raw waveforms. Phonocardiography is a non-invasive diagnostic tool for assessing cardiac function. PCG records heart sounds, providing valuable information about cardiac health. Accurate and timely diagnosis of cardiac abnormalities is critical for effective patient care. PCG provide valuable information in the form of raw waveforms, which, if properly analyzed, can aid in the early detection of cardiac issues. DNNs have shown promise in automatic cardiac abnormality detection. The research involves developing a sophisticated neural network architecture that learns and identifies intricate patterns within the PCG signals, aiming to improve the accuracy of cardiac abnormality detection. A key focus of the research is not only on achieving high diagnostic accuracy but also on making the model's decision-making process interpretable. This transparency is crucial for gaining acceptance in clinical settings. The study also compares the performance of the proposed model with existing methods, demonstrating its potential for increased sensitivity and specificity in identifying a spectrum of cardiac conditions. An overall accuracy of 97 % is achieved.

articleTitle: Driving Innovation: Creating a Dataset for Automotive Ad Campaign Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Effective marketing efforts in the automotive industry are crucial for moulding consumer attitudes and driving business growth. However, the complexity and resource-intensive nature of campaign development presents significant problems to marketers. This study introduces a novel method for streamlining campaign generation by creating a comprehensive dataset of automotive ad campaigns by leveraging the capabilities of generative AI. We carefully created our dataset utilising web scraping techniques and Large Language Models (LLMs) in an iterative, pipelined procedure. Our dataset serves as a valuable resource for a variety of tasks, including ad campaign generation, since it provides insights about key elements that influence their performance. Additionally, we provide advertising metrics to understand campaign performance along with an analysis on the quality of media that can be produced by utilizing this dataset. This has potential to transform automobile marketing operations by providing marketers with a more efficient and evolved campaign development strategy.

articleTitle: Assessing the Role of Trust & Perceived Enjoyment in VR/AR Based Banking Using TAM
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The study investigates the role of trust (T) and perceived enjoyment (PE) as factors influencing the VR&AR banking environment. Employing the technology acceptance model framework, the study aims to analyse trust and PE as exogenous variables, that shape users' acceptance and use of immersive technologies for banking services. Primary responses were collected through a structured questionnaire from the prospective adopters who prefer to use VR&AR based banking. Data was modelled using PLS-SEM and the results indicate the significant role of (T) dynamic and insignificant influence of (PE) on perceived usefulness impacting the prospective adopters’ intention to use metaverse banking. The study contributes profound understanding of extended TAM elements that motivate people to avail metaverse banking and offers a distinctive perspective paving path for future research in the field.

articleTitle: The Forensic Investigation Model to Empower Investigation Agencies in the Era of Digital Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The modern digital age has posed severe challenges for investigative authorities in conducting forensic investigations, especially regarding cybercrimes and a variety of other crimes including fraud. A generic Digital Forensic Investigation model. The Dynamic Forensic Investigation Framework Model (DFIFM) introduced in this paper is a comprehensive and strategic approach to serve as both model of digital forensic capabilities for agencies who may be ill positioned with the ability navigate through the maze of new territories on their own. DFIFM forecasts include those for innovative technologies, linking methods to new national and international cooperation models, establishment of training programmes addressing the advancement of specialization in digital investigation skills and enhanced policies/practices developed around prospective frameworks unique from traditional investigative pornography type cases. Implementation of this framework will enable investigative agencies to perform comprehensive digital forensic examinations, collect actionable evidence and prosecute crimes faster as well. In so doing, investigative agencies will be far better equipped to conduct proper and timely digital forensic analysis on mobile devices or the cloud producing solid evidentiary outcomes for prosecution against those who commit crimes in the world wide web. This study provides some deep insights into digital forensics along with the dominance of advanced tools as well i.e. machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI). A roadmap for investigative agencies planning to upgrade their potential in the fight against cybercrimes and digital offenses.

articleTitle: Classification of Fake News Across Online Social Networks Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The proposed work uses NLP (Natural Language Processing) techniques for detecting the misleading news stories that come from the non-reputable sources. The proposed model has three stages, data collection phase, data preprocessing and feature extraction phase and model building phase. After the data is collected, during the data preprocessing phase, in addition to the removal of stopwords, tokenization, lemmatization, and to remove noise from data, regular expressions are used. Logistic Regression, Decision Tree, Random Forest, Multinomial Naïve Bayes, and Support Vector Machine models are considered for the classification of fake news. The performance evaluation is made on the outcome of the models. An accuracy of 99.59 percent is achieved from Decision Tree model after the application of regular expression in data preprocessing stage. Further from the other metrics, it is noted that SVM and Decision Tree models have shown a better Precision, Recall and F1-score.

articleTitle: Analyzing the Impact of Social Media Dynamics Through Sentiment Analysis: A Case Study on Influencer-Generated Content and Response on Recommendation Systems Amidst the Lakshadweep-Maldives Situation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Our Research helps user to analyze the impact of Influencer generated Content on recommendation systems. By Understanding how sentiments expressed on social media platforms may influence recommendation algorithms is crucial and for enhancing the effectiveness and relevance in our system it needs to explore. we focus on exploring the correlation between influencer-generated content on social media platform and user responses within the geopolitical situation of Lakshadweep-Maldives. The primary goal of this research is to analyze how sentiments expressed by influencers on various platforms influence public opinion and afterward effect on recommendation system outputs. We examining sentiments across diverse sources of studying influencer content related to the Maldives and Lakshadweep geopolitical situation. We identified significant correlations between influencer activities that can shifts search patterns in the recommendation system. By conducting a comprehensive case study we aim to uncover deeper understanding of how influencer dynamics in digital spaces influence recommendation systems to shape perceptions particularly in the context of geopolitical events. This research is essential as it provides valuable insights for enhancing travel recommendation systems and making them more transparent and contextually aware to the end user.

articleTitle: Quality Assessment for 3D Coloured Point Clouds in Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel no-reference (NR) technique for evaluating the quality of 3D colored point clouds, notably for autonomous vehicle applications. Our technique intends to provide an automated and dependable framework for precisely measuring point cloud data quality by using color information, hence improving the assessment process's capacity to detect small deviations and abnormalities. Unlike existing approaches that rely heavily on geometric data, our methodology incorporates color information, which considerably enhances discrepancy detection and gives a thorough quality rating. Our proposed technique uses sophisticated deep learning models, specifically Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), to enhance the feature extraction and regression stages. By employing CNNs, we improve the model's capacity to detect detailed patterns in point cloud data, hence enhancing the accuracy and dependability of quality predictions. The technique is intended to be applicable across several domains, supporting high-fidelity applications such as entertainment, industrial quality control, and autonomous cars. It guarantees the consistency and dependability of input data, allowing for more accurate environmental perception and decision-making. The study also benchmarks against full-reference (FR) 3D-QA measures and compares the proposed NR methodology to existing methodologies.

articleTitle: Classifying Alzheimer's Disease Stages via Bootstrap Aggregation of CNN Architectures on MRI Scans
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) presents a pressing challenge in healthcare globally, necessitating timely and accurate diagnosis for effective management. Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) holds promise for AD detection due to its ability to reveal structural brain changes. However, manual MRI analysis is labor-intensive and prone to human error. To tackle these issues, this study proposes a novel method for AD classification using ensemble learning with Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architectures-specifically, CNN, Inception V3,DenseNet121, and MobileNet-leveraging bootstrap aggregation. This ensemble approach diversifies training data subsets, leading to enhanced accuracy. The proposed model achieved an impressive 84% accuracy with bootstrapping and 94 % without. Additionally, specificity values underscore the model's robustness, with 0.93 and 0.97 for bootstrapped and non-bootstrapped ensembles, respectively. This innovative approach not only improves accuracy but also addresses scalability and generalization challenges, offering promise for AD diagnosis and management based on neuroimaging data.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence-Driven Big Data Analytics for Business Intelligence in SaaS Products
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The prevalence and gravity of data-related issues facing modern businesses have propelled the field of business intelligence and analytics (BI&A) to the forefront of academic and professional discourse. A paradigm change is occurring in the way businesses make decisions and prepare for the future, and this paper explores AI and data analytics are changing the face of BI. An aim of the study was to look at BI from every angle, particularly how it has changed with the addition of AI and sophisticated data analytics, and to see where these technologies are headed in the corporate world. The combined use of BI, AI, and BDA in SaaS products is the topic of this review. It describes big data analytics, lists its essential elements, and talks about how it relates to business intelligence. The review examines AI trends in BI, examines successful sector-specific applications, suggests a Big Data Analytics Service-Oriented Architecture (BASOA), and examines SaaS adoption in BI. Further research areas encompass the AI frameworks, optimising the scalability and performance of business intelligence applications built on SaaS platforms.

articleTitle: Enhanced Multi-Model Approach for Motion and Violence Detection using Deep Learning Methods Using Open World Video Game Dataset
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: For today's environment, it is extremely important to understand hostility and motion in a variety of contexts, particularly where accidents are concerned. There's also a high safety risk in public places if there is no proper identification of suspicious activities that occur fast and cannot be accurately observed through traditional surveillance systems that rely on constant human monitoring. Although deep learning algorithms have proven useful for detecting anomalies such as fraud recently, there has been little research on real-time crime detection because of issues related privacy when using live data sets. To tackle the key problem of motion and violence detection with current deep learning methods, this work exploits the Open World Game Dataset which provides realistic activities. The reliance on only one technique undermined the previous models’ accuracy while this study comes up with various models to raise the detection precision and real-time processing capability. This work applies MobileNet SSD, YOLOv8 (You Only Look Once), and SSD (Single Shot MultiBox Detector) techniques to create a more accurate movement detection system. To identify violent or illegal behavior from videos, 3D convolutional neural networks (3DCNN) will be used alongside attention approaches. A diverse inexpensive training environment that enables simulating.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning for Role Based Access Control: Optimizing Role Management and Permission Management
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In this paper, introduce a novel machine learning (ML) approach to optimize role management and permission control within Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) systems. Leveraging the concept lattice from formal concept analysis, we propose the Role Minimization Optimization Algorithm (RMOA) to depict RBAC systems as conceptual lattices, thereby capturing interdependencies and intrinsic hierarchies among users, roles, and permissions. This method aims to minimize the number of roles while efficiently assigning responsibilities. By leveraging the Role Minimization Optimization Algorithm (RMOA) based on formal concept analysis, the approach effectively addresses the complexities of dynamic environments and enhances access control accuracy and efficiency. Key findings include the superiority of supervised learning over traditional association mining and unsupervised learning methods in handling discrete data and generating accurate access control rules. Comparative analysis demonstrates the superiority of supervised learning in generating accurate access control rules over other approaches. Future research should focus on scalability, real-world application, and enhancing the security of ML-based RBAC systems to fully realise the potential of these innovations in dynamic environments.

articleTitle: Raw-Waveform Based Bark Scale Initialized SincNet Model in Child Speaker Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)

authors.preferredName: Daggupati Venkata N R Mohitananda Sanjay

abstract: SincNet is a novel approach to child speaker identification (CSI), designed to recognize children's voices using a specialized neural network architecture. This approach utilizes specialized filters, known as sinc filters, to capture crucial information from audio signals. The effectiveness of SincNet has been verified through extensive testing, showing its ability to identify child speakers even under challenging conditions accurately. This study stands out for its focus on improving Bark scale accuracy, which closely resembles the frequency response of the human hearing system, especially at lower frequencies. This alignment helps in more accurate speech recognition, as Bark features excel at capturing details essential for human intelligibility. With Bark-scale-initialization on SincNet, the results obtained were 93.57% for standard convolutional neural network, 94.69% for constant Sincnet, and 94.41% for custom SincNet. The study utilizes the non-native children English speech (NNCES) corpus as an appropriate dataset for this research, underscoring the method's relevance and potential applications in various voice-related domains. The use of Bark scale filters in the SincNet model for CSI and the comparison of various scale initializations are two of this research's innovative features. This work closes the knowledge gap in child-focused speaker recognition by showcasing notable gains in accuracy achieved using human auditory-inspired filtering methods.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of a Hybrid Recommender System Merging Collaborative and Content-Based Strategies for Nutritional Tailoring in Children
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This research analyzes the execution of a hybrid recommender system that merges collaborative and content-based filtering techniques to convey individualized nutritional recommendations for kids. Content-based filtering systems suggest items based on their characteristics, such as accessibility and particular elements. Collaborative filtering technique examine customer's choice to recommend suitable items based on similarity. Using a single recommendation can be challenging, the purpose of research study is to compare the effectiveness of content-based filtering, collaborative filtering and their combination. The combination of these techniques looks to make a more accurate recommendation system that customizes nutrition instructions to the dietary preferences and necessity of individual children. By exploring the potential benefits of hybrid recommender systems in real-world scenarios, this research focuses on capacity and flexibility to diverse customer profiles. This research contributes appreciated insights into enhancing child nutrition recommendation system, giving a robust approach to offering customized dietary guidance to parents.

articleTitle: Digital Twins: Implementation and Employment in Technologies
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: With the rapid advancement in the field of Artificial Intelligence, the last years have witnessed various new technologies. Along with the innovation in this technology, there is also a remarkable inventory with the joint manipulation of embedded systems. The combined operation of these two advanced technology brought us to the innovation that is Digital Twin Technology. Digital Twin Technology is the new technology that embraces the use of physical world characteristics to replicate its own virtual world to provide the best possible solution in case of any situation. To provide a detailed description of the digital technology this paper is presented. In this paper, the main focus is on the implementation of Digital Twin Technology on various technologies such as wireless communication for 5G networks, 6G networks, Data security, and the Industrial Internet of Things. It also comes into optimization for the application in various domains that are manufacturing, aviation, VLSI, and healthcare. This paper briefs us about the concept of Digital Twin Technology with its impact and contribution to the new era of innovation.

articleTitle: Ensemble Techniques for Mental Illness Prediction: Development and Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Mental health has a significant impact on one's thoughts, feelings, and behaviour, making it an essential part of a person's overall well being. It affects every aspect of life, including productivity at work and relationships. Mental health concerns are frequently disregarded and ignored, despite their significance. To determine whether a patient has a mental illness or not, doctors often find it difficult to hear what the normal person has to say about their feelings. Nonetheless, for those dealing with mental health issues, early identification and treatment can greatly enhance results and quality of life. In this work, a synthetically modified real dataset is used to present a method for diagnosing mental disorders in individuals. Initially, the separate models (XGBoost, ANN and Random Forest) had mediocre accuracy. Next, an ensemble model that included the three models was developed, which led to decreased error and increased accuracy. With a single input value, the ensemble model produced accurate binary classification results. The study emphasises the value of mental health assessments in the medical field and shows how ensemble models can improve diagnostic precision.

articleTitle: Modelling a Novel Linear Transformed Attention Mechanism for Intrusion Detection Using Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: In the current global scenario of Internet of Things (IoT) pervasive development is inevitably seen. The smart networks faced cyber-attack in critical fault-lines. This situation called for IoT security imminently. The security breach not only affected the IoT but the smart devices which are deployed as botnet connected to internet across the globe is also brought into danger, this in a large view makes the whole Internet ecosystem exploited. Internet became paralyzed when the video surveillance devices were compromised by malware through an attack called denial of service (DoS). In both terms like diversity and complexity pervasive growth of security attack can be seen in the recent past. So, it is important to formulate a technique to analyse the context of IoT to detect and prevent attacks. By evaluation of defence techniques that are present, the presented survey can classify the challenges and threats for IoT networks. Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS) is focused in our study. The presented LTMA model reviews open-source and free network sniffing software as well as datasets and NIDS implementation tools which already exists. Finally, our system performs the surveys and then analyses the same and compares and contrasts the contemporary NIDS in terms of methodologies used for detection, its architecture, strategies employed for validation, deployments of algorithm and threats treated in IoT context. The review of the study in (ML) machine learning and traditional NIDS techniques are discussed and scope for future directions are presented.

articleTitle: Enhancing Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning Understanding Through EnVision: A Virtual Reality Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The quality of teaching and learning process can be improved through innovative methods like use of virtual reality. We introduce EnVision, a groundbreaking Virtual Reality based approach to revolutionize Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning (AI/ML) education. EnVision offers a unique approach where users build models through immersive learning experiences. Using interactive tutorials mixed with real-time data integration and visualization, users learn AI/ML concepts with ease. Through qualitative and quantitative methods, we evaluate EnVision's effectiveness and user satisfaction, contributing to the advancement of innovative educational gaming technologies. The evaluation results show that EnVision provides the AI/ML practitioners engaging learning experiences.

articleTitle: NeuroAI: Emerging Artificial Intelligence and Image Processing Techniques in Neuroscience for Enhanced Medical Diagnosis of Brain Tumor
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: The combination of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Neuroscience speaks to an advantageous relationship with significant suggestions. AI, a multidisciplinary field in CS which points to imitate insights in machines, whereas Neuroscience explores the brain's structure and cognitive capacities. The union of these disciplines has driven to shared headways. Neuroscience has altogether affected AI, motivating profound neural systems based on natural neural systems. AI exceeds expectations in assignments such as NLP, object detection, and speech recognition. AI, drawing from neuroscience, utilizes support learning standards watched in people and creatures to create autonomous algorithms. AI's capacity to analyze complex information and reveal unapparent design is important for interpreting neuroscience information. AI interfaces can extricate neural signals from the human brain and interpret them into commands for gadgets like automated arms, supporting those with versatility impediments. AI moreover contributes to restorative areas, analyzing neuroimaging information and supporting early discovery of neurological disarranges. This paper conducts a comprehensive audit and usage of the AI and neuroscience cooperative energy, particularly brain tumor, emphasizing their merging for untimely revelation and forecast of neurological clutters. This paper primarily centers on early identifying and localizing the brain tumor locale utilizing division of patient's MRI pictures.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Various Deep and Machine Learning Techniques for Web Service Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Finding the necessary web service is becoming a more difficult task as a result of the web services' rapid growth in repositories. It has increased the need for effective algorithms for classifying web services. The web service recognition process is enhanced when related web services are clustered or grouped together in service repositories, as this saves search time and space. In order to use vector space to depict web services, numerous distinguished In this field of study, researchers have utilized the Term Frequency - Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF), Length Feature Weight (LFW), or Deep learning approach. The TF-IDF or LFW approach generally has a number of drawbacks, such as (1) not being able to determine the semantic meanings among synonyms, antonyms, etc., and (2) Producing a large number of sparse vectors for words that are in the document but not in the corpus used to train the W2V model or unknown words. These factors also contribute to the classification algorithm's declining performance. In this work, we suggest various methods, predicated on Word2Ve for vectorized representation of service followed by classification algorithms: W2V + Naive Bayes, W2V + Random Forest, W2V + SVM, W2V + KNN, and W2V + Logistic Regression. The suggested method, as opposed to TF-IDF or LFW, which only takes into account one weight, helps extract additional information about a word from a web service and stores it in a vector. The suggested methods are used on two datasets of actual web services, and the accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score, and other standard measurement criteria are used to gauge the performance. The suggested approach's outcomes are contrasted with the K-Means(K) clustering LFW representation method. The suggested method performs better than the LFW+ K method, according to the results, and W2V+SVM produces the best outcome.

articleTitle: Blockchain or AI: Web Applications Security Mitigations
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Given the rapid advancement of web applications and the increasing importance of web security, it is crucial to prioritize web security as a fundamental aspect of ensuring a secure online environment. Web apps are becoming more and more popular, but with that comes a wider range of security threats that can cause more serious harm. To safeguard web apps and discourage cyber-attacks, numerous research have been conducted. Some security issues that might affect web applications are provided in this article. SQL injection attacks are the most prominent attacks on web applications. These attacks could allow third parties to access private information without authorization, change or remove data, or even take down whole websites and databases. Traditional methods of detecting and neutralizing SQL injection attacks are often resource-intensive, making them impractical for devices handling large volumes of traffic. Examining and evaluating blockchain and AI-based technologies for improving web application security against “structured query language injection” (SQLI) threats is the goal of this Study. A literature review has been conducted to find the applications of blockchain and AI technologies in web application protection. Taking into consideration the review, an opinion is presented regarding which technology is superior and in what circumstances.

articleTitle: Statistical and Linguistic Features Based Extractive Text Summarization for English and Hindi Languages
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Text summarization has become recognized as a prominent task within the realm of natural language processing (NLP) in the recent years. It condenses enormous amounts of information into comprehensible summaries, which promotes effective information intake and understanding. Recent advancements in Hindi and English languages have leverage a wide range of statistical and linguistic information. This paper offers an extensive examination of ten statistical and linguistic features with sum up of these ten features of each sentences in the document for text summarization at <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$n$</tex> % compression rate. It covers Hindi and English datasets from the indian language summarization (ILSUM)-2022 competition. The performance of proposed approach is better as comparisons to the other state-of-the-art methods in term of Rouge-1, Rouge-2 and Rouge-L based on recall metrics for English and Hindi languages.

articleTitle: Simuhack : A Realistic Attack Simulation Framework for Enhancing Cybersecurity in Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: As autonomous driving technology advances, modern vehicles are evolving into sophisticated digital systems. This evolution introduces new challenges for ensuring safety and security in vehicle design, particularly concerning smart sensors, Electronic Control Units (ECUs), and in-vehicle communications. Addressing these challenges requires robust security measures to mitigate potential attacks. However, real-world testing of these systems is both complex and costly. To overcome this hurdle, proposed the Simuhack framework within the CARLA software, which simulates attack datasets for comprehensive security analysis in vehicle design. Simuhack facilitates the creation of realistic attack scenarios, including GPS spoofing, V2X attacks, ECU attacks, and Replay and Bogus Information attacks commonly encountered in modern vehicles. We demonstrate the utility and effectiveness of our framework by evaluating five cyber attack scenarios using the LGSVL simulation software. Our findings underscore the critical importance of proactive security measures in safeguarding autonomous driving systems against potential cyber threats.

articleTitle: An Review on Automated Test Data Generation with Java Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Software testing has long been regarded as a useful method for raising the caliber and dependability of software. Path testing is the principal technique for improving software quality and the most reliable software testing approach overall. In a realm of software testing, the demand for efficient and comprehensive automated test data generation techniques is ever-increasing. Addressing this need, we propose a novel Hybrid ACO-NSA approach tailored for Java environments, which combines Ant Colony Optimization (ACO) and Negative Selection Algorithm (NSA). Our approach involves a methodical procedure that starts with turning the programme being tested into a control flow graph (CFG) and continues with using NSA for redundancy reduction and ACO for route tracing. It is our goal to generate highly effective test data sets with great coverage by recasting the test data generation issue as a hybrid of ACO and NSA problems. Through extensive testing and analysis, our system outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches, with complete route coverage achieved with an average of three generations and a success rate of 99.8 percent. This exceptional performance underscores the efficiency and effectiveness of the Hybrid ACO-NSA approach, positioning it as a promising solution for automated test data generation in Java programming contexts.

articleTitle: BlockMQ: Blockchain Assisted MQTT Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: This paper introduces a novel architecture that in-tegrates private blockchain technology and a distributed MQTT broker to enhance the security and scalability of telemetry transmission systems in the Internet of Things (IoT). Using Hyperledger Fabric, the approach mitigates the vulnerabilities associated with centralized communication protocols, specifically addressing the risks of single-point failures and unauthorized access prevalent in traditional MQTT systems. The methodology encompasses secure device registration, dynamic key manage-ment, and encrypted data transmissions. The system employs a Gin server behind a robust firewall for secure blockchain interactions, while a distributed EMQX broker system managed via NGINX ensures efficient load distribution and fault tolerance. The proposed architecture fortifies IoT communications against cyber threats. It supports scalability by facilitating efficient handling of a large number of device connections, thereby setting a new standard for secure IoT communication frameworks.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence and Cyber Security Driven Social Innovations in Digital Adventure Tourism
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Modern advances in artificial intelligence and cyber security can be exceptionally profitable for new businesses. These advances can offer viable answers for defending IT resources, anticipating cyberattacks, and ensuring trade progression. In this consider, an exhaustive survey of the writing has been conducted. A common outline of experience tourism is given in this paper. This consider too covers creating innovation and the components of enterprise tourism. The benefits and troubles are too highlighted.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Histopathological Image Classification Using PIP-Net
publicationTitle: 2024 First International Conference on Pioneering Developments in Computer Science & Digital Technologies (IC2SDT)
abstract: Histopathological images serve as pivotal assets within the domain of breast cancer diagnosis, demanding profound comprehension for precise interpretation. This paper introduces a histopathological image classification framework employing the Patch-Based Intuitive Prototype Network (PIP-Net). PIP-Net finds important features without the need for manual part annotations by using prototype patches and self-supervised learning mechanisms. Consequently, PIP-Net adeptly discerns novel patterns within images, thereby facilitating informed therapeutic interventions. Leveraging the ‘BrakeHis’ dataset, encompassing histopathological images of breast cancer, this paper evaluates PIP-Net's efficacy across varying magnification levels, specifically at 40x, 100x, 200x, and 400x. The classification accuracies achieved are 98.49%, 94.53%, 99.33%, and 98.08% for each respective magnification level. The integration of prototypical elements within images serves to enhance correlation with human visual perception. This shows the paper's dual commitment to not only attaining superior classification performance but also aligning with interpretability and intuitive principles integral to medical image analysis.
